title: Controller
description:
About the role

The Controller leads the accounting function for our company, with responsibility for the commercial real estate investment portfolio and the HOA and condominium communities the firm manages. The role owns the accuracy, timeliness, and GAAP compliance of all financial reporting; serves as the senior technical accounting resource for internal staff, clients, and external advisors; and directs the financial workstream for new property onboardings and new company integrations.

The Controller supervises and develops a team of Property Accountants and is accountable for internal controls, audit readiness, tax support, budgeting, and the accuracy of corporate and client invoicing. Success in the role is measured by clean and on-time close cycles, audit and tax engagements completed without material adjustment, complete and accurate bill-back capture, and transitioned properties fully reconciled and reporting on schedule.

What you'll do

Financial Reporting & Close

  • Direct the accounting department in the preparation and review of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements for commercial real estate investments and HOA/condominium communities.
  • Ensure all financial reporting is accurate, timely, and compliant with U.S. GAAP.
  • Review and approve complex journal entries, account reconciliations, and financial analyses prepared by Property Accountants.
  • Establish and maintain consistent, high-quality financial reporting standards across the organization.

Technical Accounting & Client Advisory

  • Serve as the primary financial point of contact for clients, responding to high-level accounting and financial inquiries.
  • Provide financial insight and explanation on property performance, budgets, reserves, and financial strategy.
  • Resolve complex accounting matters and provide technical guidance to internal staff.
  • Direct the preparation and review of client financial statements, budget adjustments, journal entries, account reconciliations, and cash flow projections.

Budgeting, CAM, & Reserve Planning

  • Lead the preparation and review of annual operating budgets, CAM reconciliations, and reserve analyses.
  • Confirm that monthly assessments charged agree to budgeted amounts, and investigate and resolve variances.

Tax Reporting Oversight

  • Oversee the financial preparation supporting client tax returns in coordination with external tax professionals and the internal accounting team.
  • Direct the preparation and review of annual financial reporting packages used for tax purposes.
  • Review financial data and reporting to confirm tax compliance and accuracy, and advise on tax-related accounting matters.
  • Own the annual vendor 1099 process end-to-end, including vendor data integrity, review, and filing.

Audit Oversight

  • Oversee preparation of the financial documentation and supporting schedules required for community association audits.
  • Coordinate with external auditors throughout annual audit engagements and manage the request list to completion.
  • Ensure documentation, reconciliations, and financial support are complete and available in advance to facilitate an efficient audit.

Corporate & Client Invoicing

  • Oversee and review Schedule A (Brookes) invoicing, confirming that community management fees agree to the internal tracker, that overtime hours are billed back correctly, and that credit card bill-backs are captured.
  • Oversee maintenance invoicing, including credit card reconciliation, supply bill-back review, and overtime bill-back accuracy.
  • Oversee porter invoicing, including receipt and bill-back of all Advantage supply invoices, receipt at the corporate level of all JAJ invoices used by Advantage subcontractors, and delivery of quarterly supply catch-up invoices to Continuum.
  • Confirm and collect one-off invoicing with John Speed on a monthly basis and provide supporting detail to Continuum.

New Property Integrations

  • Establish opening financial entries carried over from prior management.
  • Reconcile inherited historical ledger data and resolve opening balance differences.
  • Open and establish property bank accounts.
  • Set up recurring management fee contracts in the ERP.
  • Establish payroll for on-site employees, including union setup where applicable.
  • Serve as the accounting point of contact for clients post-transition.

New Company Integrations

  • Establish opening financial entries for legacy company properties.
  • Obtain access to the legacy company’s historical financial data and supporting technology.
  • Import and reconcile historical data into the ERP.
  • Confirm that monthly recurring contracts, including insurance and loans, are received and entered into the ERP.

Team Leadership & Process Improvement

  • Supervise, mentor, and develop a team of Property Accountants.
  • Deliver technical training and guidance on complex accounting matters and processes.
  • Implement best practices for internal controls, financial processes, and reporting procedures.
  • Review accounting workflows on an ongoing basis to improve efficiency and reporting quality.
  • Support the accounting team in maintaining high standards of accuracy and responsiveness.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
  • Seven or more years of progressive accounting experience, including at least three years supervising an accounting team.
  • Demonstrated command of U.S. GAAP and the full-cycle close for multi-entity portfolios.
  • Direct experience with real estate, property management, or community association accounting.
  • Experience coordinating external audit and tax engagements.
  • Proficiency with property management or real estate ERP systems and advanced Excel skills.

Preferred

  • CPA license or active candidacy.
  • Experience with HOA and condominium association accounting, including reserve studies and CAM reconciliations.
  • Experience integrating acquired portfolios or companies, including opening balance sheet setup and historical data conversion.
  • Familiarity with union payroll requirements for on-site personnel.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Senior Data Engineer - Data Engineering Barbican & Epsom | Hybrid Working (1 office day per week) | Permanent | Full-Time Competitive salary available, depending on experience 37.5 hours per week

At Nuffield Health, everything we give our patients, members and customers starts with our people. Your passion, your expertise and your drive to make a difference enable us to deliver exceptional connected healthcare and fitness experiences. We're looking for an experienced Senior Data Engineer to join our Data Engineering team, responsible for making data available and trusted across the whole of Nuffield Health. This is a role with real ownership: you'll own a functional area of our data platform, lead delivery initiatives and line manage engineers, setting the standards, patterns and direction that the wider team follows. Our Data Engineering team operates a distributed leadership model. Each Senior Data Engineer owns a defined functional area, such as ingestion and integration, incident management and observability, governance, security and cost management, or CI/CD and DevOps, and is accountable for the standards and resilience of that area so that nothing depends on a single person. Seniors lead delivery initiatives and line manage engineers, with the Lead Data Engineer retaining overall technical direction and the roadmap.

You’ll work with industry-leading technologies including Snowflake, dbt, Azure Data Factory, Talend, SQL Server, New Relic and Terraform.

As our Senior Data Engineer, you'll:

  • Own a defined functional area of the data platform, setting the standards, patterns and tooling the team follows within it and acting as the first point of contact for questions in that area.
  • Avoid becoming a single point of dependency by documenting your work and helping other engineers develop the knowledge and skills needed to support your area, treating knowledge transfer as an ongoing obligation rather than a one-off handover.
  • Lead delivery initiatives end to end, planning, resourcing and delivering against agreed constraints in collaboration with Product Owners, Delivery Managers, architects and third-party suppliers.
  • Line manage engineers, including objectives, development plans and reviews, and line manage external or temporary resource aligned to your initiatives for their duration.
  • Design, build and operate robust ingestion, integration and transformation solutions on Snowflake, dbt and Azure, in line with Nuffield Health's enterprise architecture and data engineering standards.
  • Ensure solutions are operationally ready, observable and supportable, and contribute to incident and problem management as part of the team's service management approach.
  • Coach mid-level engineers to take ownership of epics and smaller initiatives within their squad, growing the next generation of leaders in the team.
  • Contribute to the team's technical roadmap, BAU planning and engineering maturity, including documentation, code quality, branching and testing standards.
  • Escalate cross-cutting risks, dependencies and unassigned questions to the Lead Data Engineer, and communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

To succeed as Senior Data Engineer, you'll bring:

  • Substantial hands-on data engineering experience across integration, data modelling and data warehousing, with excellent SQL skills.
  • Experience with ETL/ELT tools (e.g. Talend, Azure Data Factory, dbt) and database platforms (e.g. MS SQL Server, Snowflake, Azure SQL Database), including developing integration solutions using APIs, files and databases.
  • Experience with performance tuning, data migration strategies (on premise and cloud) and relational database design, particularly in support of business intelligence.
  • Experience setting and upholding engineering standards, and taking ownership of quality and outcomes for a technical area.
  • Experience leading the delivery of a project or initiative, working with Product Owners, Delivery Managers, architects and third-party suppliers to manage scope, dependencies and risk.
  • Line management or mentoring experience, or a clear appetite to develop it with structured support.
  • Excellent communication skills, including documenting technical design proposals and translating complex technical concepts for technical and non-technical audiences.

Desirable:

  • Observability and incident management tooling, such as New Relic and ServiceNow.
  • CI/CD, DevOps and infrastructure as code, such as Terraform and Azure DevOps.
  • Data governance and security: data masking, GDPR, access auditing, PII handling, role-based access and cloud cost management.
  • Experience in healthcare or another regulated environment.

We will provide:

  • A wide variety of interesting and challenging work that involves most of Nuffield Health's systems, working with key stakeholders such as data analysts, data scientists and business intelligence teams.
  • Genuine ownership of a functional area and the initiatives you lead, within a community of data engineers where your opinions shape the standards and practices we adopt.
  • A structured path into technical leadership and people management: training pathways, shadowing and reverse shadowing, a Seniors peer group, and regular reviews with the Lead Data Engineer.
  • Opportunities to learn and develop your career through apprenticeships, self-learning, mentoring and training courses, with progression encouraged both within the team and across Nuffield Health.
  • An environment that allows you to perform at your best, working collaboratively with colleagues who are focused on improving the health of our nation and making a real difference to people's everyday lives.
  • Helping you feel good. We want you to love coming to work, feeling healthy, happy and valued. That's why we've developed a benefits package with you in mind. Here, you can choose from a range of fitness, lifestyle, health and fitness wellbeing rewards, such as free gym membership, health assessments, retail discounts and pension options.
  • At Nuffield Health, we take care of what's important to you.

#CentralSupport Nuffield Health, is the UK's largest healthcare charity. For over 60 years, we've been working to make the UK fitter, healthier, happier and stronger. All for the public benefit. We do this through our family of 31 award-winning hospitals, 113 fitness and wellbeing centres, healthcare clinics and over a 100 workplace wellbeing services. As a charity, we reinvest all our income into our services, into pioneering improvements in care, and most importantly into our social impact programmes, which are designed to support people who would not normally be able to afford or access our services. Its all part of our mission to give everyone the care they need and to build a healthier nation.

title: Trade Associate - Fixed Income
description:
About the role

Tidal is seeking a highly skilled Trading Associate to support the implementation and day-to-day management of multiple ETF portfolios, with a particular emphasis on fixed income trading, cash positioning, and collateral management. The ETF Portfolio Management team provides portfolio management and execution services for ETF issuers across active and index-based strategies covering major global asset classes.


This hands-on role spans the full trade lifecycle, including execution support, trade allocation, settlement, reconciliation, cash forecasting, collateral monitoring, fund rebalances, new fund launches, and custom in-kind baskets. The ideal candidate brings meaningful fixed income trading experience, strong analytical and operational judgment, and proficiency with Bloomberg or comparable institutional trading platforms.

What you'll do

Trading and Portfolio Management

  • Assist traders with executing and managing fixed income and equity transactions, with a strong emphasis on fixed income markets.
  • Use Bloomberg, order management systems, and other institutional platforms to support efficient trade execution and portfolio oversight.
  • Support portfolio rebalances, new fund launches, and custom in-kind baskets, with the expectation of independently managing these responsibilities over time.
  • Work closely with prime brokers, market makers, custodians, and other counterparties to support best execution and improve fund efficiency.
  • Monitor market trends, economic developments, portfolio positioning, and performance relative to fund objectives and direct competitors.
  • Build strong working relationships with internal teams and external stakeholders, and perform additional duties as assigned.
  • Perform daily trading operations, including trade allocation, settlement monitoring, and reconciliation across fixed income and equity activity.


Cash and Collateral Management

  • Prepare and distribute daily cash position reports for assigned ETF portfolios.
  • Monitor inflows and outflows, investigate exceptions or variances, and communicate cash movements to internal and external stakeholders.
  • Track account balances and forecast liquidity needs to maintain appropriate cash and collateral coverage.
  • Coordinate collateral and margin activity with counterparties and support the timely movement or return of excess cash and collateral.
  • Use Bloomberg and counterparty portals to gather information, investigate breaks, and resolve discrepancies.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in business, finance, economics, a quantitative discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • At least 3 years of experience in institutional trading, portfolio operations, treasury, or cash management, including demonstrated fixed income trading experience.
  • Institutional or registered investment adviser trading experience.
  • Proficiency with Bloomberg or a comparable institutional trading platform.
  • Strong understanding of financial markets, trading strategies, trade settlement, reconciliation, and collateral processes.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and working knowledge of the Microsoft Office suite.
  • Strong analytical, communication, and complex problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to manage deadlines, maintain attention to detail, and perform effectively in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with trading platforms, order management systems, and post-trade processing.
  • Knowledge of cash forecasting, reconciliation, margin, and collateral-management processes.
  • Experience working for a firm that manages investment companies registered under the Investment Company Act of 1940.
  • Familiarity with regulatory requirements related to trading activities.
  • Proximity to Chicago or Omaha preferred

Operating in a complex environment that includes multiple delivery partners, contractors, consultants, and senior government representatives, the Director plays a critical role in advancing projects of substantial public interest and strategic importance to the province.

We are interested in candidates who bring:

title: Software Engineer II - Capacity & Efficiency Engineering
description:
About the Role and Team

As a Software Engineer II on CEE, you will build the systems that decide how much infrastructure Uber needs, where it runs, and what it costs. Our capacity planning platform turns business demand forecasts into resource plans, targets, and quotas across compute, storage, and data infrastructure, so engineering teams can ship without over-provisioning and Finance can trust the numbers.

The problems here are messy and the systems are global. Demand is uncertain, cost attribution spans many systems, and plans get revised every forecast cycle. You'll need to make smart decisions with imperfect information, own your work end-to-end, and stay calm when a planning deadline or a high-load production pipeline is on the line. We are looking for engineers who think in systems, pride themselves on robust monitoring and data correctness, and believe the best solutions are built through candid feedback and cross-functional collaboration. If you're energized by challenges and motivated to move the real world, this is where you'll grow.

What You'll Do

  • Design, develop, and maintain high-quality code for the capacity planning stack, including resource demand-to-supply forecasting models, plan-of-record pipelines, and the services that publish and manage capacity and spend plans. The scope ranges from features of moderate complexity to projects with multiple dependencies.
  • Build and scale the data pipelines that join business demand, resource consumption, and cost attribution, balancing technical debt and shifting planning cycles while keeping long-term impact in mind.
  • Improve the accuracy and explainability of capacity forecasts and models, and validate changes by backtesting against historical data.
  • Own the software lifecycle end-to-end, from drafting design docs to debugging production issues and managing incidents independently, including keeping planning pipelines correct and on time around forecast deadlines.
  • Collaborate across disciplines, including Product, Data Science, Finance, and infrastructure platform owners, to translate ambiguous requirements into simple, elegant system designs.
  • Champion engineering best practices by providing quality code reviews, writing comprehensive tests and data-quality checks, and improving system performance.
  • Navigate internal complexity and stakeholder inquiries to unblock dependencies and ensure the reliability of our production environment.

Basic Qualifications

  • 3+ years of professional software engineering experience in backend development, distributed systems, or data engineering.
  • Proficiency in one or more object-oriented or functional programming languages (e.g., Go, Java, Python, or C++).
  • Experience with data modeling, query optimization, and translating customer problems into system design.
  • Bachelor's Degree (or equivalent experience) in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Experience writing tests to verify functionality and establishing monitoring systems to ensure code stability.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with forecasting, optimization, or statistical modeling, and with turning a model into a reliable production system.
  • Familiarity with capacity planning, resource quotas or scheduling, or cost showback or chargeback systems.
  • Proficiency with Big Data frameworks (e.g., Spark, Flink) or real-time data streaming (e.g., Kafka).
  • Experience identifying and reducing code-level technical debt in high-load distributed systems.
  • Demonstrated ability to exercise sound judgment on engineering trade-offs for complex features and to make progress in high-ambiguity environments.
  • Background in mentoring new team members and contributing to engineering culture.
  • Strong communication skills, with a track record of translating complex technical concepts for diverse stakeholders.

For San Francisco, CA-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $171,000 per year - USD $190,000 per year.


For Sunnyvale, CA-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $171,000 per year - USD $190,000 per year.


For all US locations, you will be eligible to participate in Uber's bonus program, and may be offered an equity award & other types of comp. All full-time employees are eligible to participate in a 401(k) plan. You will also be eligible for various benefits.

  • Excellent diagnostic and troubleshooting abilities.

  • Excellent communication skills.
  • Attention to detail, especially as it relates to identifying potential changes to or problems with manufacturing equipment or processes.
  • Knowledge of Preventive Maintenance practices.
  • Ability to read, understand, and interpret schematics and drawings.

Senior Assembly Technician

Founded in 1980, Urban Resource Institute (URI) is the nation’s largest provider of domestic violence shelter and support services and a leading provider of housing and services for families experiencing homelessness. URI’s work is grounded in survivor-centered, trauma-informed, and culturally responsive care. In addition to emergency and transitional housing, URI delivers a robust continuum of Justice Initiatives—including economic empowerment, legal education and advocacy, prevention and youth programming, and abusive partner intervention—designed to break cycles of violence, instability, and poverty. title: Assistant Cultural Resources Technician 2
description:
GAI has immediate openings for Full-Time Cultural Resources Technician 2 to support various field projects across the Southwestern region. These employees will be responsible for identifying, excavating, and recording potential sites, washing and/or processing artifacts for laboratory analysis, and assisting with various laboratory tasks associated with post field activities in accordance with federal and/or state archaeological standards. Projects may include Phase I through Phase III, historic and/or prehistoric investigations. Pre-employment drug testing is required for the above opportunities.

Job Duties:

  • Accurately document and map survey areas, testing locations, excavations, and any observable cultural resources.
  • Accurately complete paper and/or electronic field forms.
  • Record soil color and type using a Munsell soil chart.
  • Use a compass for basic orienteering within the project vicinity.
  • Work outdoors in varying weather conditions.
  • Ability to walk 8 to 10 miles a day (sometimes in rugged terrain), while carrying tools and equipment.
  • Perform any and all other duties assigned by supervisor.

Qualifications:

  • B.A. or B.S. degree in Archaeology/Anthropology or a related field (completion of academic field school preferred).
  • Minimum one to three years CRM experience in North America preferred.

  • Willingness to travel (required) and with independent means of transportation (preferred).
  • Experience in archaeological field excavation techniques, artifact identification, data recording, mapping, and surveying.

Physical Requirements:

  • Use fine motor skills to handle delicate objects, write by hand, feel sharp objects, and reach with hands/arms
  • Possess satisfactory close range vision, distance vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus
  • Talk, hear, taste or smell

  • Hike over various types of terrain while carrying up to 25lbs of gear

  • Work outdoors in extreme temperatures and weather conditions

Travel:

General Characteristics

Minimum Years of Experience

  • 1 to 3 Years of Experience

Education

  • B.A./B.S. Degree in Anthropology, Archaeology, History, Historic Preservation, American Studies, or associated degree; enrolled in field school; or equivalent skills and experience

Technical Responsibilities

  • Primarily field position; excavation skills; basic knowledge of soils; accurate note taking and completion of field forms; sketch maps; basic photography; basic compass/navigation skills

Communication Skills

  • Possess oral and written communication skills; interacts with well with other staff, ability to function positively in a team environment; ability to communicate effectively with supervisor, coworkers and with lesser experienced personnel, ability to convey field results clearly and concisely to senior level cultural resources staff

Why GAI?

GAI offers an exceptional place to do meaningful work, grow your career, and make a real impact in communities nationwide. title: San Antonio TX - Transportation Specialist
description:
Every transport at NORA supports a life-saving transplant.
As a Transportation Specialist, you play a critical role in a coordinated medical logistics chain where timing, safety, professionalism, and sound judgment can directly impact patient outcomes. This role requires disciplined execution, operational awareness, and the ability to remain calm and focused in time-sensitive situations without compromising safety or protocol.
This is not routine driving. It is precision service work performed alongside clinical teams who rely on your reliability, composure, and clear communication.
What You’ll Do

Transport surgical teams, organs, tissues, and critical medical supplies safely and efficiently.

Operate in both emergency and non-emergency situations, using sound judgment while maintaining strict adherence to safety protocols.

Communicate clearly and proactively with dispatch teams and clinical partners.

Monitor for potential delays, safety concerns, or process gaps and escalate issues through established channels.

Maintain a professional, composed approach in time-sensitive and clinically sensitive environments.

On-Call Commitment
This is a true on-call position. During scheduled on-call periods, you must remain reachable and prepared to respond when dispatched. When you are not actively deployed, you are free to use your time as you choose.
Dispatch activity can vary, and weekly hours are not guaranteed.
Tissue & Donor Transport Responsibilities - Location Specific
At designated NORA service locations, Transportation Specialists may assist with the respectful transport of tissue donors in accordance with medical, regulatory, and clinical protocols.
This responsibility requires:

Professional composure and discretion

The physical ability to safely perform required duties

Strict adherence to established procedures and protocols

Sensitivity and professionalism in clinically and emotionally significant environments

This responsibility applies only to designated NORA service areas.
What Sets NORA Transportation Specialists Apart

Calm, disciplined decision-making in time-sensitive situations

Safety-first vehicle operation — urgency never takes priority over established protocols

Clear, concise communication with dispatch and clinical partners

Operational awareness to identify and escalate safety, timing, or protocol concerns

Professional composure in clinically and emotionally sensitive environments

Commitment to reliability — understanding that every transport plays a role in the transplant process

Qualifications

Minimum 5 years of emergency vehicle operation experience; red lights and sirens experience preferred

Background in law enforcement, fire service, or career EMS preferred

Valid driver’s license with a clean driving history

Must be 25 years of age or older

Ability to safely operate a stretcher with up to 200 pounds of patient weight

Successful background and drug screening; criminal charges and convictions may be considered if substantially related to the position

If you are seeking meaningful, mission-driven work that values discipline, composure, and service excellence, we invite you to apply and become part of the transplant community’s trusted transport partner.

  • Proactive, adaptable and flexible when responding to different situations.

  • Eagerness to learn and continually develop professionally.
  • Genuine interest in the construction and property industry.

title: Field Service Rep - Saginaw, MI
description:

As a Field Stocking Associate, you will be responsible for stocking and maintaining Moulding merchandise in aisles at Home Depot stores within the Saginaw, MI area. (Stores located in Bay City, Saginaw, Midland and Flint)

  • Monthly Cell phone allowance + Mileage reimbursement.
  • Paid weekly!

Required Credentials:

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Software -Teams, Excel, Word, and Outlook. Along with time keeping system and mileage system.
  • Must have a strong commitment to providing excellent customer service to store management and customers.

We serve 45 states in the U.S. and 8 provinces in Canada from over 40 locations. Here at SBP we are a people first organization, our team is built upon strong culture and standards for success.   • 401(k) with Company Match
  • Company-Paid Time Off

We are also committed to our core value of “using our influence to have a uniquely positive impact” on the people that we touch. title: Software Engineer
description:
**Worker Type**

Regular

**Job Description**

As a **Software Enginee** r at AV, you’ll develop software to control advanced robotic platforms from AV and industryleaders including Boston Dynamics, Red Cat, FLIR, Skydio, QinetiQ, Parrot, and more.  You’ll play a key role in developing Kinesis, our flagship software ecosystem that enables users to collaboratively control a diverse set of robots.

This role is ideal for engineers who take ownership, enjoy working hands-on with hardware, and bring structure and clarity to complex systems. You’ll be trusted to move quickly, make sound decisions, and continuously improve our product and execution.

**Position Responsibilities:**

- Software development in support of AV’s vision-based navigation, autonomy, cooperative behaviors, and mission systems technology roadmap.

- Design, implement, and integrate systems in C++ and Kotlin.

- Develop cross-platform applications for Android, Linux, and Windows to control robotic platforms.

- Design SDK interfaces for internal and external integration with AV systems.

- Perform hands-on field testing with robots to validate new features.

- Delivers work on time according to agreed completion dates and project schedule & budget.

- Supports and derives algorithm design from detailed software requirements.

- Works closely with multiple teams of software developers reusing developed software to support different programs.

- Operates in a continuous learning environment and provides guidance and mentoring to less experienced engineers.

- Works on significant and unique issues where analysis of situations or data requires an evaluation of intangibles.

- Acts independently to determine methods and procedures on new or special assignments.

- Occasional travel for customer or testing events.

- Other duties as assigned.


**Basic Qualifications (Required Skills & Experience):**

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Math, or Physics is required or equivalent combination of education, training, and experience with 5+ years of relevant experience.

- Strong fluency in modern C++, maintainable software architecture, and modular system design

- Experience evaluating product design tradeoffs and translating them into clear system requirements

- Hands-on knowledge of CMake or similar build systems

- Experience developing software for mechatronic or hardware-integrated systems

- Knowledge of computer networking topologies, protocols, and principles

- Self-directed engineer who takes ownership and brings structure to complex systems

- Ability to engage directly with technical and non-technical customers

- Ability to leverage AI tooling to improve engineering productivity and code quality

- Ability to obtain a US DoD Secret clearance if required

- Willingness to travel locally (Occasionally)


**Other Qualifications & Desired Competencies:**

- Advanced degree is preferred

- Familiarity with safety critical software concepts such as determinism and real-time systems

- Experience with UAS, drones, robotics, autonomous vehicles, or other embedded systems

- Experience with CI/CD pipelines (Gitlab or similar)

- Android/Linux application development experience

- Experience with Docker

- Experience with FastDDS, gRPC, MQTT, or similar networking protocols

- Experience designing and delivering APIs and SDKs to third-party developers

- Demonstrates leadership skills and sound judgment in selecting methods and techniques for obtaining solutions

- Demonstrates effective listening, questioning, clarifying and summarizing skills to effectively communicate in one-on-one and small group settings

- Demonstrates understanding of system design that one is working on and understands the role that assigned tasks play in the system

- Able to excel in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment, where small teams share a broad variety of duties

- Displays strong initiative and drive to accomplish goals and meet company objectives

- Takes ownership and responsibility for current and past work products

- Is committed to learning from mistakes and driven to improve and enhance performance of oneself, others, and the company

- Has effective problem-solving, analytical, interpersonal and communication skills

- Focuses on teamwork, collaboration and puts the success of the team above one's own interests


**Physical Demands:**

- Ability to work in an office environment (Constant)

- Required to sit and stand for long periods; talk, hear, and use hands and fingers to operate a computer and telephone keyboard (Frequent)


**Special Requirements:**

- _**U.S. Citizenship i** **s required.**_

- Occasionally may be required to travel within the Continental U.S.


**ITAR Requirement:**

_This position requires access to information that is subject to compliance with the International Traffic Arms Regulations (“ITAR”) and/or the Export Administration Regulations (“EAR”). In order to comply with the requirements of the ITAR and/or the EAR, applicants will be asked to provide specific documentation to verify U.S. person status under the ITAR and the EAR.  A “U.S. person” according to their definition is a U.S. citizen, U.S. lawful permanent resident (green card holder), or protected individual such as a refugee, or asylee. See 22 CFR § 120.15._ _Some positions will require current U.S. Citizenship due to contract requirements._

**Benefits**:  AV offers an excellent benefits package including medical, dental vision, 401K with company matching, a 9/80 work schedule and a paid holiday shutdown.  For more information about our company benefit offerings please visit:  [http://www.avinc.com/myavbenefits](http://www.avinc.com/myavbenefits).

We also encourage you to review our company website at [http://www.avinc.com](http://www.avinc.com) to learn more about us.

Principals only need apply.  NO agencies please.

**Who We Are**

Based in California, AeroVironment (AVAV) is a global leader in unmanned aircraft systems (UAS) and tactical missile systems. Founded in 1971 by celebrated physicist and engineer, Dr. Paul MacCready, we’ve been at the leading edge of technical innovation for more than 45 years. Be a part of the team that developed the world’s most widely used military drones and created the first submarine-launched reconnaissance drone, and has seven innovative vehicles that are part of the Smithsonian Institution’s permanent collection in Washington, DC.

Join us today in developing the next generation of small UAS and tactical missile systems that will deliver more actionable intelligence to our customers so they can proceed with certainty – and succeed.

**What We Do**

Building on a history of technological innovation, AeroVironment designs, develops, produces, and supports an advanced portfolio of unmanned aircraft systems (UAS) and tactical missile systems.  Agencies of the U.S. Department of Defense and allied military services use the company’s hand-launched UAS to provide situational awareness to tactical operating units through real-time, airborne reconnaissance, surveillance, and target acquisition.

title: Shipping & Receiving Clerk 1st shift
description:
Job Summary
We're looking for a Shipping & Receiving Clerk to support the movement of materials, parts, and finished products throughout our aerospace manufacturing operation. In this role, you'll receive incoming shipments, prepare outbound orders, maintain inventory accuracy, and ensure products are shipped safely, accurately, and on time. You'll play a critical role in supporting production schedules and customer deliveries.

Work That Matters
At Chromalloy, your work directly supports aviation safety and reliability. Our teams repair and manufacture critical aerospace components used across the global aviation industry. What you do here has real-world impact—every day.

Shift: 1st shift, Monday-Friday 5:30a-2:00p

What You’ll Be Doing

Receive, inspect, and verify incoming shipments against purchase orders, packing slips, bills of lading, and other shipping documents.
Accurately count, weigh, and record incoming and outgoing materials.
Prepare products for shipment, including packaging, labeling, crating, and documentation.
Determine appropriate shipping methods to meet delivery requirements.
Process shipments using carrier systems and shipping software.
Route materials and products to the appropriate departments and work centers.
Maintain accurate shipping, receiving, and inventory records.
Investigate and document shipping discrepancies, shortages, or damaged materials.
Monitor inventory of shipping supplies and packaging materials to support production needs.
Safely operate forklifts, pallet jacks, hand trucks, and other material handling equipment.
Load and unload trucks and move materials throughout the facility.
Support the handling and transportation of hazardous materials in accordance with established safety and regulatory requirements.
Perform data entry and maintain records using systems such as Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Word.

What We’re Looking For

High school diploma, GED, or equivalent experience.
Ability to clearly communicate in English, including speaking, reading, writing, and understanding work instructions.

1-3 years of shipping, receiving, warehouse, logistics, or material handling experience.
Experience working with shipping documentation, inventory records, and receiving processes.
Basic computer skills, including Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Word.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
Ability to prioritize work and manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.
Strong organizational and problem-solving skills.
Ability to communicate effectively and work cooperatively with production, quality, and customer support teams.
Commitment to workplace safety and quality standards.

Nice to Have

Experience with FedEx, UPS, or other carrier shipping software.
Forklift certification or previous forklift operating experience.
Experience in aerospace, manufacturing, distribution, or industrial environments.
Familiarity with inventory management systems and shipping compliance requirements.
Experience handling hazardous materials or regulated shipments

Work Environment & Physical Requirements

Manufacturing and warehouse environment with frequent movement throughout the facility.
Regular lifting, carrying, pushing, and pulling of materials and shipping containers.
Frequent use of packaging tools and material handling equipment.
Ability to safely lift and move materials and products as required.
Frequent standing, walking, bending, and reaching.
Exposure to shipping, receiving, warehouse, and production areas.
Ability to safely operate forklifts, pallet jacks, and other material handling equipment.

title: EFP - Purchasing Agent

Extremely organized and able to work with minimum supervision.

-Innovate based on new ideas and build comprehensive system/features.

An engineer in Selling Partner Identity Verification Tech spends time addressing operational excellence for software they own, identifying issues in existing systems, proposing solutions and resolving those through the natural software development lifecycle, while proposing changes to team process to prevent future gaps in their software.

title: Embedded Software Engineer (m/f/d) - ADAM Audio GmbH
description:
Embedded Software Engineer (m/f/d) – ADAM Audio GmbH

Location: Berlin offices / hybrid

Term: Full-time, permanent

Salary: Depending on experience

Start date: as soon as possible

  • Are you passionate about engineering and its application to acoustics and audio reproduction?
  • Are you an Embedded Software Engineer looking to join an innovative team for creating audio products?

If the answer to these questions is yes, then we’d love to hear from you!

At ADAM Audio, our profound passion for audio and acoustics drives our pursuit for excellence. We are pushing the boundaries of innovation in the field of audio and acoustics. Our commitment to excellence and cutting-edge engineering drives our mission to deliver ground-breaking solutions to our customers. The successful candidate with have previous experience in audio electronics.

Your Role and Responsibilities:

  • You will be collaborating closely with cross-functional and multi-cultural teams across the company and external partners, to define, prototype and develop products from early sketches on to market introduction and maintenance.
  • On a day-to-day basis you’ll be responsible for providing the firmware code for our hardware products, including evaluation of new technologies, debugging prototype hardware and ensuring your code is suitable for mass production and complies with latest market regulations (CE, FCC, CRA etc.). You'll have the opportunity to shape the direction of our embedded projects and you’ll be involved in the project's lifecycles. You’ll be refining product specifications, producing innovative designs and solutions and engaging with a multi-discipline team. You’ll be planning your activities, estimating your work and collaborating to meet deadlines and product requirements as well as working hands-on at functional prototypes and evaluation boards to debug and test electronic hardware designs with your code on it.
  • Individual and team development is important, and we’ll support you as you look for ways to grow and improve your personal knowledge and skills. We’ll also be looking for you to own and help improve our approach to embedded software engineering, including best practices, processes, and tools. There will also be opportunities to share knowledge and practices with all companies across the Focusrite group.

Skills and Experience Required:

  • Expert experience with micro-controllers and audio DSP (Digital Signal Processing) in general
  • Mastery in low-level programming at ARM-based-microcontrollers (STM32, NXP, etc.) and RTOS
  • Experience in C and modern C++ programming and common frameworks like Zephyr
  • Experience in working at systems with hard real-time constraints
  • Mastering a range of test equipment: oscilloscopes, logic analysers, bus analysers and audio analysers (Audio Precision)
  • Experience with meeting compliance regulations and standards (CE, FCC, EMC, RED, LVD etc.) for USB-, wireless- and Ethernet-connectivity, and battery powered devices
  • Experience with common Bluetooth and RF SoCs like Qualcomm, Airoha, Bestec etc.
  • Experience with networking protocols and chips/modules for Ethernet, WiFi and BLE
  • Strong ability to analyse and present trade-offs between cost, quality, and development time
  • Hands-on problem-solving and debugging skills, including lab work (test equipment, soldering etc.)
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with multi-disciplinary teams
  • Good English language skills (spoken and written) and ideally good German language skills.

Beneficial:

  • A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Information Technology, Electronics Engineering (or other relevant technical disciplines)
  • Familiarity with electronics and/or audio engineering.

What can you expect from us?

Well, our colleagues are fantastic, of course! Here are some more good reasons to join our team:

  • Flexible working hours for a better work-life balance
  • A healthy mix of remote and office work
  • A harmonious and appreciative working atmosphere
  • Work on exciting projects in a unique industry as part of an international brand group
  • Employee discounts, including on Focusrite, Novation and Sequential products
  • Opportunities for professional development
  • ADAM Audio bonus programme – our employees share in the company's joint success!
  • Company pension scheme, ADAM Audio health programme, mental health first aiders, FeelGood Manager, Business Bike programme, regular staff events and much more.

You don’t have all the experience we’ve asked for?

Our priority is to find the right fit for the team and for the company, and we will always do what we can to support your individual development. In other words, if you don’t quite have all the experience listed above, we’d still be interested in hearing from you. Let us know what you would bring to the role, and why you’d be a great fit for the team.

We look forward to receiving your application!

About us

ADAM Audio GmbH is a rapidly growing, internationally positioned Focusrite plc company based in Berlin Adlershof.

We are one of the market-leading manufacturers of professional monitoring solutions.

Our customers include renowned recording studios and well-known music producers all over the world, and our products have also been used to soundtrack numerous Oscar-nominated films in recent years.

Since 2019, ADAM Audio has been part of Focusrite plc which houses other, highly respected pro audio brands like Martin Audio, Optimal Audio, Sequential, Focusrite, Focusrite Pro, Novation and Ampify. Our international team at the Berlin-based HQ and the office in China live our passion for music. We constantly drive ourselves to bring fresh ideas and new technologies to our high-quality products to meet the needs of pro audio enthusiasts and recording professionals alike.

We pride ourselves in providing some of the tools that empower creatives all over the world to bring their visions to life. Covering a wide range of products for different levels and budgets, we engage with artists, producers and engineers to become a companion throughout the various stages of their journey.

Our whole business is structured to let everyone contribute and be heard at all levels, and we make sure it’s a great place to work. As a team, we work hard and support each other to master our individual tasks, building and developing the skills of talented and passionate people – to achieve a common goal. So, if you think you can bring something new to the mix, we look forward to hearing from you.

ADAM Audio is an equal opportunity employer. Our employees span a wide range of diverse backgrounds, and we believe that embracing diversity is one of the keys to our future success.

title: Powerline Technician (Journeyperson / Apprentice) - 8-Month Contract
description:
What You Will Do:

The Powerline Technician is responsible for the construction, maintenance, and repair of overhead and underground powerlines and related equipment in accordance with established safety procedures and best practices. The incumbent works collaboratively as part of a crew to complete assigned tasks efficiently and in compliance with company standards. Depending on their level, the successful incumbent will either continue their apprenticeship or carry out journeyperson-level responsibilities, including mentoring junior team members.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Construct, maintain, and operate both overhead and underground electrical distribution systems.
  • Participate in job planning activities, including completing tailboards, to assess hazards and coordinate tasks.
  • Set up appropriate work area protection in compliance with safety standards.
  • Perform line work using approved methods such as rubber glove techniques and live line tools.
  • Install, maintain, and operate various system components including poles, conductors, guy wires, switches, switchgear, transformers, cables, splices, terminations, and substation components—on the ground, at height, or in confined spaces.
  • Safely operate and maintain motorized vehicles and equipment such as bucket trucks, radial boom derricks, aerial devices, portable generators, power saws, and drills.
  • Conduct pre-trip inspections of vehicles and equipment to ensure operational readiness and safety compliance.
  • Maintain a professional and courteous demeanor when interacting with customers and the public.
  • Execute switching operations as directed by the Control Room, ensuring full compliance with the Utility Work Protection Code (UWPC).
  • Respond to power outages on a 24/7 basis, including diagnosing issues, performing repairs, and restoring service to customers.
  • Communicate with System Control personnel to report defective equipment and unsafe conditions, and to verify adherence to tag-out/lock-out procedures.
  • Participate in standby rotation and respond to emergency callouts as required.
  • Assist in the training and mentorship of Apprentice Powerline Technicians (Journeypersons).
  • Engage in ongoing training and development programs to maintain and enhance technical and safety competencies.
  • Maintain a thorough understanding of, and adhere to, all applicable safety legislation, Electrical Utility Safety Rules (EUSR), and GrandBridge policies, procedures, and safe work practices.
  • Position may be required to work in both service areas.


What You Will Bring:

  • Meet or exceed the requirements of a 2nd Year Powerline Technician Apprentice in terms of hours worked, schooling status, competencies, and skills.
  • Proficient with the construction of overhead and underground electrical distribution systems.
  • Possess strong technical knowledge on the operation of the electrical distribution system, as well as the electrical equipment and mapping that comprises the electrical system.
  • Experienced in the troubleshooting and repair of the electrical distribution system.
  • Proficient in all aspects of loading and operating requirements for digger and aerial device trucks, as well as associated rigging techniques.
  • Working knowledge of the Electrical Utility Safety Rules, Book 7 Traffic Manual, and relevant aspects of the company Health and Safety program to safely work on the electrical distribution system.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize tasks effectively and safely, often working in stressful conditions and high-pressure situations.
  • Proficient with MS Office and utilization of relevant software programs.
  • A self-starter with the ability to work effectively in a team environment and follow instructions from supervisors and peers.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to work with multiple stakeholder groups and a commitment to fostering a positive and inclusive workplace culture.
  • Valid DZ license in good standing.

Working with the Client Partner, the team is responsible for managing the Clients property portfolio, with a focus on delivering excellent service and maintaining strong occupier relations.

The Property Administrator will support the Client Partner and property management team to coordinate the Clients portfolio including reporting, data management, KPI attainments and overseeing one off projects.

What matters most in this role

Building and maintaining close professional relationships with Clients, Occupiers and the PM teams is paramount to your success.

You will have experience with multi-tasking and working towards tight deadlines. You will regularly deal with a range of enquiries quickly and efficiently.

Attention to detail is crucial, especially in the maintenance of our databases, approving contractor invoices and preparing quarterly reports to send to clients.

You must have strong working knowledge of Microsoft Word, Excel, Teams and Sharepoint.

Day to day, you’ll

  • Coordinate and collate updates for monthly/quarterly reporting, including chasing PM teams, preparing and checking output as well as ensuring reports are delivered on time.
  • Ensuring the PM teams update trackers at the required intervals and escalating to the Client Partner where appropriate.
  • Submitting trackers and reports by the deadlines set. Reviewing and suggesting more efficient ways of working or simplified processes.
  • Support the PM team to develop and implement emergency response plans.
  • Act as the point of contact for data queries, coordinating the response from the various PM teams. Carrying out regular data integrity checks and updating the property management systems.
  • Support the PM team on the completion of service charge budgets and reconciliations.
  • Review and update Health and Safety Reports with measures provided by the PM team to reduce risk.
  • Provide support with sustainable property management, to include the collection, management and analysis of utility data.

What we expect of you

  • Previous experience of working in property management with knowledge of service charges, including budgets and other relevant standards is desirable.
  • Resilience and ability to work within the dynamic nature of the property market whilst adapting to changing circumstances and processes.
  • An understanding of UK property laws and regulations, including safety standards would be beneficial.
  • A proactive, practical, and positive approach to work

Our core belief

Great Workmanship starts with getting the fundamentals right.

Even though we're in the property business, we're all about the people.

Everything we do is built on collaboration, empowerment, autonomy, and integrity – not just words, but how we actually work.

Why Workman?

Hybrid working to offer you a great work life balance, with a minimum of three days in the office.

Core working hours to allow for added flexibility and helps ease your commute to the office.

Study support (where applicable)

Discretionary annual bonus and salary reviews.

Healthcare, life insurance & wellness programme.

Long service additional holidays, your birthday off and an extra day between Christmas and New Year.

Lifestyle benefits to suit you: gym membership, cycle to work, buy and sell holiday to name just a few.

Social events throughout the year including a firm wide Christmas party!

Generous referral bonus.

About Workman

As the UK’s leading independent commercial property management specialist, Workman has an enviable position within the property industry.

We are proud of our longstanding relationships with many of our clients, some of whom we have worked with for more than 25 years. Our clients include leading institutional and sector-specialist investors, private property companies, public sector bodies and a growing number of overseas investors.

We pride ourselves on the calibre of our employees and their unique skill sets.

For more information on working for Workman please visit our website: WORKMAN.CO.UK/OURPEOPLE

title: Senior Director, Data & Analytics
description:
THE ROLE
We are seeking a forward-looking Senior Director, Data & Analytics to lead and evolve UPP’s enterprise data capabilities. Reporting to the Managing Director, Data and Technology, this role will work with business and technology leaders to improve how data is governed, integrated, managed and used across UPP. Its scope includes data in UPP’s enterprise data hub and across the broader cloud solutions ecosystem, including Google Cloud Platform (GCP). The Senior Director will help ensure data is trusted, accessible and fit for business reporting, analytics, automation and emerging AI workloads.
This is an opportunity for an experienced data leader to shape an important enterprise capability and help UPP make better use of its data as the organization grows.
This role is based in downtown Toronto under a hybrid work policy, allowing employees the flexibility to work remotely and in-office (two days per week in-office).
This posting is for an existing vacancy.
SPECIFIC ACCOUNTABILITIES
The Senior Director, Data & Analytics will lead and evolve UPP’s data capabilities, including the following:

Develop and evolve UPP’s enterprise data strategy and practices so data is well governed, reliable, discoverable and useful across the organization.
Lead and develop a high-performing team responsible for data quality, data engineering, data integration, data operations and analytics enablement.
Establish data standards and practices in partnership with business data owners, Architecture, Cybersecurity and other technology teams.
Guide the use of cloud-based data capabilities, including GCP, to support reliable data integration, reporting and analytics. Improve data quality, access, lineage and governance so data is ready for responsible automation and AI workloads, in partnership with the teams accountable for AI platforms, architecture, privacy and cybersecurity.
Partner with business and technology leaders to prioritize data needs and enable trusted, data-informed decisions. Establish the access patterns, tools, standards, training and controls that allow business users, including citizen data users, to work with data safely and at scale.
Improve the reliability, quality, reuse and maintainability of data integration and transformation flows that support key processes, including pension data conversion, regular employer reporting, and Finance reporting and analysis.
Leverage leading frameworks (such as DCAM) to continually mature and evolve the data strategy and frequently self-asses the capabilities for progress
Define and communicate data priorities, target capabilities and roadmaps, aligning plans with enterprise needs and available capacity.
Research and establish peer connections to understand industry trends and their applicability to support data plans and strategies for the enterprise
Explain the value of trusted data and sound data management practices to technical and non-technical audiences.
Oversee UPP’s data catalog and related metadata practices, working with Architecture and data owners to improve data discoverability and stewardship.
Contribute to UPP’s reputation as a respectful employer, partner, and participant in the financial sector

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

10+ years of demonstrated experience developing and leading enterprise data capabilities, including data governance, data engineering, integration, data operations and analytics.
CDMP (Certified Data Management Professional) or an equivalent qualification is an asset.
Significant progressive experience in data management, including data governance, architecture, integration, data quality, metadata and analytics.
Experience leading data teams or capabilities in a cloud-based environment, with sufficient technical understanding of data platforms, databases, integration and transformation tools, analytics and visualization to set direction and make informed decisions. Experience with GCP or comparable cloud data platforms is an asset.
Understanding of relational and non-relational data and the considerations involved in integrating and governing different data types.
Experience working across complex business domains; experience in pensions, investments or financial services is an asset.
Experience designing and evolving cloud-based data capabilities in partnership with internal teams and external service providers.
Working knowledge of analytics methods and the interpretation of quantitative information.

ATTRIBUTES

Excellent written and verbal communications
Ability to design and improve repeatable data practices
Ability to drive outcomes through collaboration across teams and contributors
Ability to engage and align business users, data owners and technology partners.
Ability to effectively identify emerging technologies, trends, standards, and products that have a strong potential to better enable UPP business units
Ability to enable consistent, governed data use at scale.

title: Major Shareholding Reporting Analyst
description:
**Job Description**

Aberdeen Group plc is one of Europe’s largest investment companies, and we are built on a long-standing culture of caring about the future and making a positive impact. Together we invest for a better future. We do it to make a difference to the lives of our clients and customers, our employees, society, and our shareholders. Our business is structured around three distinct areas focused on our clients' changing needs: Aberdeen Investments, Aberdeen Adviser, and interactive investor.

As a Major Shareholding Reporting Analyst, you’ll help deliver vital regulatory reporting that supports our purpose and enables our clients to be better investors.

**About the Department**

The Major Shareholding Reporting team sits within the wider Regulatory Reporting function in Investment Operations. The team monitors investment positions and produces regulatory disclosures across global jurisdictions, ensuring Aberdeen meets complex reporting obligations accurately and on time. Working closely with Risk, Compliance and external partners, the team plays an important role in reducing regulatory risk and supporting investment activity.

**About the Role**

**Please note this role is a Fixed Term Contract, lasting 12 months**

We are seeking a Major Shareholding Reporting Analyst to join our Regulatory Reporting team on a 12-month fixed-term contract. This role is ideal for someone with experience in investment operations, regulatory reporting, legal or compliance who thrives in a deadline-driven environment. You will be responsible for monitoring reportable positions, producing disclosures and supporting regulatory compliance across multiple jurisdictions. You will also contribute to process improvement and automation initiatives.

**Key Responsibilities**

- Produce major shareholding disclosures and ensure regulatory obligations are met accurately and on time.

- Monitor and calculate reportable positions and proactively escalate approaching thresholds.

- Perform daily, weekly and monthly reporting activities across global markets.

- Work with Risk, Compliance and third-party providers to maintain effective reporting processes.

- Identify opportunities for process improvements, automation and risk reduction.

**About the Candidate**

- Experience in operations, regulatory reporting, legal or compliance.

- Understanding of Major Shareholding Reporting rules across one or many jurisdictions

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

- Strong IT skills and interest in process improvement.

- Experience within the investment management industry

We are proud to be a Disability Confident Committed employer. If you have a disability and would like to apply to one of our UK roles under the Disability Confident Scheme, please notify us by completing the relevant section in our candidate questionnaire. One of our team will reach out to support you through your application process.

We want you to be the real you throughout our recruitment process. Sharing your diversity information helps us understand the reach and impact of our hiring practices and build a workplace where all people can thrive and belong. This information is kept separate from your application and is not visible to recruiters, hiring managers, or assessors at any stage.

**Our benefits**

There's more to working life than coming home with a good salary. We have an environment where you can learn, get involved and be supported.

When you join us, your reward will be one of the best around. This includes 40 days’ annual leave, a 16% employer pension contribution, a discretionary performance-based bonus (where applicable), private healthcare and a range of flexible benefits – including gym discounts, season ticket loans and access to an employee discount portal. You can read more about our benefits [here.](https://www.abrdn.com/corporate/careers/professional-careers/benefits)

**Our business**

Enabling our clients to be better investors drives everything we do. Our business is structured around three distinct areas – our vectors of growth – focused on our clients’ changing needs. You can find out more about what we do [here](https://www.abrdn.com/corporate/about-us).

**An inclusive way of working**

Whatever way you like to work, if you have the talent and commitment to join our team, we’d like to hear from you.

At Aberdeen we’ve adopted a ‘blended working’ approach. This approach combines the benefits of face-to-face collaboration, coaching and connecting in our offices with the flexibility of working from home. It enables colleagues to find a balance that works for their roles, their teams, our clients and our business.

[An inclusive culture](https://www.abrdn.com/corporate/about-us/diversity-and-inclusion), where diverse perspectives drive our actions, is at the core of who we are and what we do. If you need assistance with your application, or a reasonable adjustment to your interview arrangements – for example, because you are neurodivergent, or have a physical, sensory, cognitive, mental, visible or invisible disability – please let us know and we’ll be happy to help.

### We’re committed to providing an inclusive workplace where all forms of difference are valued and which is free from any form of unfair or unlawful treatment.  We define diversity in its broadest sense – this includes but is not limited to our diversity of educational and professional backgrounds, experience, cognitive and neurodiversity, age, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, religion or belief and ethnicity and geographical provenance.  We support a culture that values meritocracy, fairness and transparency and welcomes enquiries from everyone.

### **If you need assistance or an adjustment due to a disability please let us know as part of your application and we will assist.**

title: Help Desk Analyst
description:
Make a Difference Where It Matters Most

At CalPrivate Bank, we believe banking is personal. We have deep roots in the communities we serve, and our client relationships are built on genuine care, thoughtful problem-solving, and unwavering integrity. Our solutions-based service, paired with best-in-class talent, sets us apart in the market, but it’s trust that defines who we are. It's our gold standard, the currency we trade in, and the foundation of every decision we make. 
 
We’re looking for leaders who want more than a title. We’re looking for team players who want to make an impact. If you're driven to lead with purpose, ready to shape the future and have meaningful impact at a relationship-centered bank, CalPrivate Bank may be the place for you.

Your Opportunity: Helpdesk Analyst

The Helpdesk Analyst serves as a key point of technical support for employees, helping ensure that technology works reliably, securely, and efficiently across the organization. This role is responsible for supporting, implementing, maintaining, and troubleshooting software applications, end-user hardware, and related technology while ensuring systems are maintained in accordance with applicable regulatory requirements and organizational policies and procedures.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical troubleshooting skills with a service-oriented mindset. They are responsive, organized, curious, and comfortable translating technical issues into practical solutions for users with varying levels of technical expertise. This position requires a hands-on professional who can manage competing priorities, resolve issues efficiently, and contribute to a positive end-user experience.

What You’ll Do

  • Create, assign, update, prioritize, and resolve service requests and incidents through the IT helpdesk ticketing system, maintaining accurate documentation through resolution.
  • Monitor and respond to the IT Helpdesk phone line and other established support channels, providing timely and professional assistance to end users.
  • Consult with users to understand application and technology needs, business objectives, functionality, features, workflows, and input/output requirements.
  • Provide technical assistance and troubleshooting for software applications, hardware, access issues, errors, and other end-user technology concerns.
  • Implement, configure, maintain, and support assigned software applications, ensuring appropriate functionality, security, documentation, and adherence to organizational standards.
  • Coordinate and implement software patches, upgrades, and application updates following appropriate testing and validation prior to production deployment.
  • Image, configure, deploy, maintain, and troubleshoot desktops, laptops, peripherals, and other end-user technology.
  • Travel to office locations as needed to support hardware deployments, installations, upgrades, and onsite troubleshooting.
  • Develop, edit, maintain, and distribute required or requested system and operational reports.
  • Train and assist end users in effectively utilizing applications, systems, and technology tools, including communicating changes and new functionality.
  • Identify recurring technical issues, investigate root causes, and partner with appropriate internal or external resources to drive resolution.
  • Maintain accurate technical documentation, procedures, configurations, and support records.
  • Follow established information security, access management, change management, and technology control procedures.
  • Adhere to all applicable banking regulations, privacy requirements, information-security standards, and organizational policies and procedures, including requirements related to customer and financial information.
  • Perform other duties and technology-related projects as assigned.

AML/CFT/Compliance Responsibilities

This position includes direct interaction with customers and prospects and therefore includes responsibilities relating to BSA/AML. The employee is responsible for understanding and following the Bank’s BSA/AML policies including elevating suspicious activity to the BSA Officer. Additionally, the employee is required to understand and follow the Bank’s compliance program.


Who You Are

Experience & Expertise

  • Previous IT Helpdesk, Service Desk, Desktop Support, or similar end-user technology support experience required.
  • Experience working with IT ticketing/service management systems and managing incidents and service requests through resolution. Experience with ServiceNow preferred.
  • Hands-on experience troubleshooting desktop and laptop hardware, software applications, peripherals, and common end-user technology issues.
  • Experience imaging, configuring, deploying, and maintaining workstations.
  • Working knowledge of software installation, application updates, testing, patching, and troubleshooting.
  • Strong customer-service orientation with the ability to communicate effectively with users at all levels of technical proficiency.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and documentation skills.
  • Ability to travel between office locations as business needs require.
  • Experience working within banking, financial services, or another highly regulated environment is preferred.

Mindset & Values

  • You lead with accountability, integrity, and consistency.
  • You thrive in a collaborative environment where transparency and follow-through matter.
  • You model professionalism, calm under pressure, and a solutions-oriented mindset.
  • You embrace data-driven decision-making while maintaining a client-first perspective.
  • You embody CalPrivate’s culture, heart for client, excellence in service, and deep commitment to the Bank and its people.

Physical Demands

  • Requires 50% travel between regional offices to support team members, clients, and cross-functional initiatives.
  • Ability to sit or stand for extended periods of time.
  • Ability to physically use a keyboard/mouse
  • Ability to walk to and from workstations
  • Ability to frequently lift and/or move up to 10lbs and occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds.
  • Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision and ability to adjust focus

Why CalPrivate Bank?

This isn’t just another bank job. At CalPrivate Bank, you will be part of something bigger. Our day-to-day operations and projects don’t just impact a balance sheet, they influence real people, real businesses, and the communities we proudly serve. We are guided by our commitment to relationships, solutions, and trust. And we’re building a team of people who reflect those values in everything they do.

If you’re looking for a place where your work will matter, your ideas will be valued, and your growth will be supported, welcome to CalPrivate Bank! Ready to lead with purpose?

Nice to have but not Required!
