We Are Kerry:

Kerry is the world's leading taste and nutrition company for the food, beverage and pharmaceutical industries. Every day we partner with customers to create healthier, tastier and more sustainable products that are consumed by billions of people across the world. Our vision is to be our customers' most valued partner, creating a world of sustainable nutrition. A career with Kerry offers you an opportunity to shape the future of food while providing you opportunities to explore and grow in a truly global environment.

Why Join Our Team:

Our Seattle, WA facility is an integral part of our Beverage division, specializing in the production of sweet syrups and sauce variations for Kerry customers and brands. This state-of-the-art production site features advanced technology and a collaborative team environment, where employees are encouraged to support one another's success. The facility offers opportunities for professional growth through structured training and hands-on experience, all guided by dedicated leadership. In addition to focusing on quality manufacturing, the Seattle team enjoys an energetic and inclusive workplace culture, enhanced by engagement programs, volunteer days, and activities that make work both rewarding and enjoyable. If you're seeking a place to develop your career in beverage production while being part of a dynamic and fun team, our Seattle location stands out as an excellent choice.

What You'll Do:

The Quality Technician plays a critical role in ensuring products meet quality, food safety, regulatory, and customer requirements throughout the manufacturing process. This position supports production operations by conducting inspections, testing, monitoring processes, and verifying compliance with Good Manufacturing Practices (GMPs), sanitation standards, and company quality systems.
The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, committed to food safety, and enjoys working in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
Key responsibilities include:
  • Perform pre-operational (Pre-Op) inspections to verify equipment and production areas are clean, sanitary, and ready for startup.
  • Conduct quality inspections and testing of raw materials, in-process products, and finished goods.
  • Monitor production processes to ensure compliance with food safety, quality, and regulatory requirements.
  • Document inspection and test results accurately and maintain quality records.Identify, report, and support resolution of quality and food safety issues.
  • Conduct GMP, sanitation, and environmental monitoring audits.
  • Support investigations, corrective actions, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Partner with Production, Maintenance, and Operations teams to maintain product quality and compliance.
  • Follow all safety policies, procedures, and regulatory standards

What You'll Need to Succeed:

  • Bachelor’s degree (B.S.) from a four-year college or university in Food Science, Biology, Microbiology, or Chemistry or related experience ideal.
  • 2-3 years in Quality role in food, pharma or chemical production experience preferred
  • Formerly trained in HACCP (hazard analysis critical control point system) and able to effectively train essential plant employees in HACCP principles and SQF principles ideal.
  • Skill in organizing resources and establishing priorities.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and SAP.
  • Knowledge or experience of FDA, Local, State, Federal regulations pertinent for the manufacturing facility.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills and the ability to work effectively with a wide range of constituencies in a diverse community.
  • Ability to analyze and assess training and development needs.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality of records and information.
  • Skill in examining operations and procedures and implementing new strategies and procedures.

What We Offer:

The hiring range for this position is $28.00-32.00 per hour. Kerry typically does not hire an individual at the top or near the top of the range, as we are a pay-for-performance company, and this range is set to continue to reward performance annually while in role. Compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. The specific compensation offered to a candidate within the above range may be influenced by a variety of factors including skills, qualifications, experience, and internal equity. Kerry offers a competitive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, paid time off, a 401(k) plan with employee and company contribution opportunities, Employee Share Plan, Life, disability, and accident insurance, and tuition reimbursement. This job posting is anticipated to expire on October 12, 2026.

title: Research Associate Data Scientist - Tatonetti Lab - Data-Driven Precision Pharmacology
description:
Join us as we translate today's discoveries into tomorrow's medicine!

The Tatonetti Lab is dedicated to making drugs safer through data analysis. Every day, millions of us or our loved ones take medications to manage our health. We trust these prescriptions to improve our lives and give us hope for a healthier future. However, these drugs can sometimes have harmful side effects or dangerous interactions. Each year, adverse drug reactions affect millions of patients and cost the healthcare industry billions of dollars. At the Tatonetti Lab, we use advanced data science methods, including artificial intelligence and machine learning, to investigate these medicines. By leveraging emerging resources such as electronic health records (EHRs) and genomics databases, we aim to identify for whom these drugs will be safe and effective—and for whom they will not. To learn more, visit Tatonetti Lab at Cedars-Sinai.

Are you ready to be a part of breakthrough research?

The Research Associate Data Scientist participates in biomedical research projects using programming, data-mining, statistics, machine learning, and visualization techniques to develop, evaluate, and/or apply algorithms and software for data analysis. Responsibilities include querying databases, data processing, supervised and unsupervised machine learning, deploying production models, and communication of scientific findings via peer-reviewed publications and scientific conferences. Writes clean, performant, reusable code managed on GitHub to perform repeatable analyses and to train and deploy models to multiple environments.

Primary Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Assists with the development, evaluation, and/or application of computational and statistical methods including artificial intelligence and machine learning algorithms and software for the analysis of biomedical data.
  • Assists with the presentation and communication of scientific results through laboratory meetings, scientific conferences, and peer-reviewed publications.
  • Creates database-to-deployment pipelines for models using the necessary programming languages (primarily R, Python, SQL).
  • Creates sustainable data science infrastructure and adheres to data analysis/machine learning best practices.
  • Performs exploratory data analysis to gauge the need for or appropriateness of advanced analytical methods.
  • Works with senior or lead data scientists and principal investigators to identify areas where data science can best be applied to answer biomedical research questions.
  • Tests and validates code to ensure robustness of data applications with version control through GitHub.
  • Performs all other duties as assigned.

Education:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Sciences, Machine Learning, Applied Mathematics, Econometrics, Statistics, Engineering, Physics, or related field, required. Master's degree, preferred.

Experience and Skills:

  • No prior professional experience required.
  • Experience programming at an intermediate skill level with a high-level programming language such as R or Python. College projects may be acceptable.
  • Experience in biomedical machine learning is preferred.
  • Working knowledge of data privacy and security including best practices for data with personal health identifiers (PHI) covered under HIPAA.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills. And has full command (verbal and written) of the English language.
  • Demonstrates commitment to customer service and an ability to meet the needs and expectations of patients and health care colleagues.
  • Demonstrated success working independently, forging relationships, and managing multiple tasks with minimal directions.
  • Ability to promote and foster participation/collaboration among individuals and groups.
  • Ability to handle multiple demands and/or manage complex and competing priorities.
  • Ability to analyze qualitative and quantitative information for decision support.
  • High level of proficiency using Microsoft Windows and other Microsoft Office software: MS Excel, Outlook, Powerpoint Word, etc.

title: Director, Category Management - Data Center Cooling & Mechanical System

About the role

The Director, Category Management – Data Center Cooling drives the global end-to-end category strategy, strategic sourcing, and supplier development for hyper-scale data center mechanical infrastructure. In this senior role, you will manage a multi-hundred-million-dollar annual spend across key thermal management systems, including Chillers, Computer Room Air Handlers (CRAHs), Air Handling Units (AHUs), Direct-to-Chip Liquid Cooling, and Containment solutions.


You will act as the primary commercial authority for critical thermal suppliers, aligning engineering roadmaps, securing manufacturing capacity, and establishing resilient, cost-optimized supply chains to support rapid global data center deployment.


What you'll do

  • Category Strategy & Execution: Develop and execute multi-year global strategic sourcing strategies for mechanical cooling commodities to ensure capacity, quality, and total cost of ownership (TCO) optimization.
  • Supplier Relationship & Development: Manage executive-level relationships with Tier-1 and Tier-2 cooling OEMs. Drive supplier capacity expansion, technical innovation, and performance scorecards.
  • Commercial Negotiation & Contracting: Lead complex negotiations for Master Purchasing Agreements (MSAs), Long Term Agreements (LTAs), long-lead capacity reservations, and SLA frameworks.
  • Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner closely with Data Center Design Engineering, Operations, and Construction teams to align cooling technology roadmaps with future compute architectures (e.g., high-density AI/HPC workloads).
  • Risk Management & Supply Resiliency: Map multi-tier supply chains to identify and mitigate single-point-of-failure risks, lead-time bottlenecks, and geopolitical constraints across raw materials and components (e.g., compressors, fans, coils).
  • Market Intelligence: Monitor market trends, commodity price fluctuations (copper, aluminum, steel), refrigerant regulations (e.g., HFC phase-downs, low-GWP transitions), and vendor capacity constraints to inform executive decision-making.

What you'll bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Business, or a related technical discipline. Master’s degree or MBA preferred.
  • 10+ years of progressive strategic sourcing or supply chain management experience, with at least 5 years specifically dedicated to critical data center infrastructure, industrial HVAC, or heavy mechanical capital equipment.
  • Deep technical and commercial understanding of mechanical cooling systems (Chillers, CRAHs, AHUs, Liquid Cooling, Cooling Towers, CDUs).
  • Demonstrated track record of structuring complex, high-value contracts and capacity reservation agreements with global OEMs.
  • Strong cross-functional leadership, communication, and executive presentation skills. Proven ability to influence internal engineering stakeholders and external vendor

Compensation and Benefits

  • Competitive Salary: $185,000 - $200,000 (commensurate with experience) + bonus + sign-on equity grant.
  • Long-Term Growth: Eligible to participate in Riot’s equity incentive programs and share in the success you help build.

  • Comprehensive Health Coverage: Multiple medical plan options, including 100% company-paid plans.
  • Wellness & Lifestyle Perks: Enjoy free gym memberships, pet insurance, childcare discounts, and more to support your life both in and out of work.

Our employees and the neighboring community will also benefit from the associated investments from the Commonwealth including infrastructure updates, public transportation improvements, and new access to Reagan National Airport.

- Develop, communicate and maintain project road maps

A day in the life
About AWS

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Why AWS?

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge-sharing and mentorship. Our senior members enjoy one-on-one mentoring and thorough, but kind, code reviews. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects that help our team members develop your engineering expertise so you feel empowered to take on more complex tasks in the future.

AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS)

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Inclusive Team Culture

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.


About the team
The vision of e Cornerstoe Team is to provide global controllership across a portfolio of secure spaces for AWS customers operating in highly-regulated environments by driving efficiency and standardization. We work backwards from unique customer regulations, access to classified systems, and user experiences to offer solutions that enable customers to deliver upon their mission. Our service, Secure Space as a Service, centralizes strategic, operational, and tactical functions to deliver efficient operations for AWS customers.

Our customers are global, unique, and diverse; our services must adapt and provide efficient solutions to drive parity across all spaces globally.

title: Wayne Township Assessors Office - Real Estate Appraisal Deputy
description:
Under the direction of the Senior Real Estate Appraisal Deputy, the Real Estate Appraisal Deputy maintains accurate, equitable, and fair assessed values for all residential properties within Wayne Township by using established methods and guidelines provided by the State’s Department of Local Government Finance and the International Association of Assessing Officers. This position is Covered as defined by The Board of Commissioners of the County of Allen Employee Handbook.
ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

Conducts on-site visits to any parcel in Wayne Township that has been issued permits for new construction, improvements, or demolitions to ensure all data remains accurate.
Works within the Real Estate Appraisal team to complete on-site visits and detailed reviews of every parcel in Wayne Township within a four-year period as required for Cyclical Reassessment, collecting all information regarding land and structural improvements and correcting any interior and exterior features of each parcel.
Maintains up-to-date photographs of all structures and captures visible conditions issues as needed.
Verifies information and makes final validation determination for all real estate transactions within sixty (60) days of the sale to ensure data is accurate and reliable when used for both determining market trends and conducting sales comparison analyses.
Enters findings into CAMA (Computer Assisted Mass Appraisal) system for on-site inspections prior to the roll to the state of annual trending and ratio studies.
Researches, collects, processes, and maintains market data to be used for annual trending. Prepares and calculates neighborhood factors and applies those annual trending factors to each neighborhood to establish balance between assessed values and sales data using the methods prescribed by the Department of Local Government Finance (DLFG) and the International Association of Assessing Officers (IAAO).
Performs detailed analysis of individual properties at the request of the property owner using three prescribed methods of valuation (cost, income, and sales approach) and conducts preliminary hearings with taxpayers regarding property tax assessment appeals.
Communicates and educates appellants regarding procedures surrounding both the valuation and appeal procedures and guidelines.
Collects vital information as to the condition, use, and market value using a variety of methods including, but not limited to, detailed home inspections, direct sales comparisons, rental documentation, professional estimations of cost-to-cure, professional appraisals, and any additional information the taxpayer may provide.
Compiles data and findings from appeals in great detail and formally presents it to the Allen County Property Tax Assessment Board of Appeals (PTABOA) when an agreement cannot be reached.
Acts as an expert witness for the County Assessor and formally presents detailed findings during appeal hearings before the Indiana Board of Tax Review (IBTR).
Works with the County Auditor and County Assessor to interpret legal descriptions of parcels and accurately process land combinations and splits following deed updates.
Analyzes quality control reports to ensure all information, taxation caps, property classifications, and valuation methods are correct and consistent in multiple databases, researching and correcting any errors as needed.
Processes correction of error with the County Auditor as needed to refund taxpayer overpayment.

ESSENTIONAL FUNCTIONS (Continued):

Answers telephone and determines the nature of the call, answering questions or directing to appropriate individual or agency. Assists taxpayers at counter, answering questions or directing to appropriate individual or agency. Assists taxpayers, realtors, tax representatives, disclosure preparers, and individuals from other government agencies regarding information about valuations, assessments, and many other general topics.
Assists the public with online tools developed by the Wayne Township Assessor’s office to help understand the property tax assessment processes, guidelines, and restrictions.
Navigates a variety of tax-related programs including, but not limited to, INcama, LOW, Laredo, Cost Tables, and GIS maps.
Builds, maintains, and updates a working knowledge of building construction requirements, costs, and the various laws, restrictions, and guidelines which surround them.
Assists the Records and Personal Property teams by fielding calls from recent buyers/sellers to help determine validity of sales and assists with on-site inspections to identify new and/or existing businesses. Reviews quality control reports to help ensure accuracy of other teams as needed.
Regularly attends continuing educational classes to maintain state required certifications and to obtain further and more in-depth knowledge of the tax assessment processes.
Regularly attends meeting within Wayne Township and with the Allen County Assessor to ensure all processes are being correctly followed and to brainstorm further ideas to streamline current procedures to become more consistent, uniform, and efficient.
Performs all other duties as assigned, including overtime as required.

REQUIREMENTS:

High School Diploma or GED with knowledge of the duties and responsibilities of Assessors in the State of Indiana including rules and regulations set forth by the State of Indiana and the Department of Local Government Finance (DLGF). Associate’s Degree preferred
Level III Indiana Assessor-Appraiser license, or obtain Level II license within 6 months of hire and obtain Level III one and a half (1.5) years after receiving Level II license.
Bi-annual completion of continuing education to maintain Level III Indiana Assessor-Appraiser
Valid Driver’s License required while operating county owned vehicles, to perform on-site inspections
Strong computer skills with the ability to use Microsoft Office and other job related software including INcama, Laredo, LOW, Cost Tables and GIS maps
Knowledge of mandates by the State of Indiana and the Department of Local Government Finance (DLGF)
Strong verbal and written communication skills
Ability to use various office equipment including, but not limited to multi-line phone system, copier, fax, printer, digital camera, scanner, and calculator
Experience with real estate transactions preferred
Resident of Wayne Township preferred

DIFFICULTY OF WORK:
The Real Estate Appraisal Deputy performs work that consists of complex, varied, non-standardized tasks requiring the application of numerous laws, rules, and regulations to ensure that procedures are consistently followed, and records concerning business personal property and mobile homes are accurate. Accuracy and timeliness must be maintained or property taxes for business owners and mobile home residents could be negatively affected. Errors in work are readily detected when work is reviewed after completion.

RESPONSIBILITY:
The Real Estate Appraisal Deputy makes choices and decisions while performing detailed analysis on individual properties at the request of the property owner and while conducting preliminary hearings with taxpayers regarding tax assessment appeals. Work requires some analysis and judgment when verifying information and making final validation determinations.
PERSONAL WORK RELATIONSHIPS:

The Real Estate Appraisal Deputy maintains frequent communication with other County employees, realtors, tax representatives, individuals from other government agencies and taxpayers regarding information about valuations and assessments.

WORKING CONDITIONS:

The Real Estate Appraisal Deputy performs work in a standard office setting and on-site inspections requiring some standing, walking, and frequent sitting. Some lifting up to twenty pounds, some bending, pushing and/or pulling loads, reaching overhead, kneeling and crawling are required. Frequent typing including proofreading, attention to detail, monitoring equipment, and performing detailed inspections is required. Some exposure to temperature extremes, noises, and noxious odors/fumes occur, and may result in exposure to hostile homeowners and/or pets.

SUPERVISION:
None

LICENSING:
Level III Indiana Assessor-Appraiser license or obtain within one and a half (1.5) years of date of hire.
Bi-annual completion of continuing education to maintain Level III Indiana Assessor-Appraiser
Valid Driver’s License required while operating county owned vehicles to perform on-site inspections

IMMEDIATE SUPERVISOR:
Senior Real Estate Appraisal Deputy

HOURS:
8:30 am – 5:00 pm; 37.5 hours/week; overtime as required

EEO CATEGORY:
0906

WORKERS’S COMP CODE:
9410

This Employee is also able to assist Members with the completion of fraud, dispute claims and IRA requests. This position also supports vault, operations and concierge responsibilities. This position will also have exposure to understanding Loan Product Knowledge.

This role will also be called upon to process LBS account transactions for Members waiting for service at the Teller line as needed.

You will be working with Members and your teammates to meet and exceed individual and Credit Union goals. You must enjoy a fast-paced work environment and thrive on delivering quality customer service!

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Able to escalate situations to the Branch Leadership Team, as needed, and delivers excellent service during all Member interactions.
  • Achieves established goals as measured by the Employee Scorecard.
  • Participates actively in Branch Meetings and MCR Meetings
  • Maintains up to date knowledge of all compliance regulations related to loans, new accounts and operations.
  • Dependability is important and must have predictable attendance and adhere to the LBS standards for attendance and punctuality.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced team environment.
  • Previous experience providing product recommendations and referrals.
  • Ability to handle multiple priorities simultaneously with a calm, friendly demeanor.
  • Demonstrate detail orientation.
  • Consistently demonstrates professional manner and attire.
  • Ability to learn new systems, policies and processes quickly.
  • Previous experience with cash handling and balancing a cash drawer.
  • Requires a high school diploma or equivalent.
  • Requires a minimum of one-year platform sales and loan experience, within a financial institution.
  • Requires effective verbal and written communication skills, sales skills and proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel and Outlook applications.

BENEFITS & TOTAL REWARDS

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision 100% employee-only plans paid by LBS
  • 12 Paid Holidays, 3 weeks PTO, and Sick Time
  • Defined Benefit Pension Plan
  • 401(k) and Roth(k) Retirement Plans

title: Senior Energy Engineer
description:
Enica Engineering, a division of Willdan Group Inc, provides services built on its industry-leading controls expertise and unique, hands-on project delivery. We offer services in project development, building automation engineering, control system optimization, energy metering, and field engineering services. Our clients include major medical campuses, universities, hospitals, and pharmaceutical and industrial firms in the greater New York area.


The Senior Energy Engineer ensures buildings operate at peak performance by applying expertise in energy project development/ implementation, retro-commissioning (RCx), building operations optimization, and on-site troubleshooting/ investigation. This role combines technical execution, client engagement, and leadership, requiring strong collaboration with design, construction, and facility teams to reduce energy waste, improve system reliability, and enhance occupant comfort. The role requires regular exercise of independent judgment in matters of significance, including project execution, technical recommendations, and client advisement. This role also requires the engineer to be a subject matter expert in their chosen field.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Energy Project Development & Execution
    • Manage and deliver targets as an On-site Energy Manager at various buildings.
    • Conduct and oversee site visits, inspections, and assessments of mechanical systems.
    • Develop and implement energy projects for our clients. This includes but is not limited to leading a team to complete:
      • Project identification and Feasibility
      • Scope of Work Development
      • Project Budgeting
      • Energy Modeling and Analysis
      • Utility Analysis
      • Financial Analysis
    • Troubleshoot and oversee system performance verification on a continuous basis while setting up procedures to scale this task.
    • Collaborate with contractors and vendors to ensure correct installation and operation of building automation systems and HVAC equipment.
    • Support retro-commissioning by analyzing existing systems, identifying inefficiencies, and recommending corrective actions.
    • Document and resolve deficiencies with contractors and facility staff.
    • Lead retro-commissioning team activities for HVAC, lighting, controls, and building automation systems.
    • Develop and implement retro-commissioning plans, pre-functional checklists, and functional test procedures.
  • Energy Systems & Optimization
    • Use data acquisition and analytics to optimize energy usage and performance.
    • Apply modeling tools and simulations to support control strategies and benchmarking.
  • Design & Construction Support
    • Lead project engineering teams in energy modeling and engineering report development for specified optimization of building automation and control systems (BAS/BMS) in client facilities.
    • Review design documents for constructability, energy performance, and operational effectiveness.
    • Provide commissioning input during design to align with Enica’s performance and sustainability standards.
    • Participate in factory witness testing, submittal reviews, and inspections.
    • Support project managers with RFIs, punch lists, and project closeout.
  • Technical Documentation & Training
    • Produce system schematics, wiring diagrams, logic narratives, manuals, as-builts, and training guides.
    • Deliver training to clients and internal teams.
  • Client Engagement
    • Meet with clients regularly to understand goals, provide guidance, and present recommendations clearly.
    • Build strong relationships to support repeat business and new opportunities.
    • Deliver presentations and reports that communicate future energy projects that deliver savings and client success, performance gaps, and corrective actions.
    • Support sales with technical input, scope development, and budget estimates.
  • Project Leadership & Collaboration
    • Provide technical oversight and mentorship to junior engineers.
    • Coordinate with owners, architects, engineers, and contractors to ensure cohesive execution.
    • Review vendor/subcontractor deliverables, submittals, and change requests.
    • Perform QA for several types of deliverables – i.e., audit the QC of the reviewers.

Job Requirements / Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in mechanical, electrical, or a related field of engineering is required.
  • PE or CEM is preferred.
  • Additional project development, engineering, and energy related professional certifications are a plus (e.g. LEED-AP, CEM, DBIA, etc.)
  • Working knowledge of NY/NJ utility incentive programs (ConEd, NYSERDA, NJ SmartStart) is required
  • Five or more years of progressive project development experience.
  • Experience in Public Sector energy engineering with hospitals, pharmaceuticals, research laboratories, commercial offices, and higher education preferred.
  • Excellent initiative, and interpersonal communications skills required.
  • Demonstrates engineering and analytical acumen to develop complex solutions and build credibility.
  • Experience working on complex projects and interdisciplinary teams of professionals.
  • Moderate regional travel required with possibility of limited national travel; overnight travel occasionally required.

Applicants are considered for all positions without regard to race, religious creed, color, age marital status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, citizenship status, national origin, ancestry, religion, military service or veteran status, disability, medical condition, childbirth and related medical conditions, genetic testing, reproductive status or any other classification protected by federal, state or local laws and ordinances. title: Data Engineer - Databricks
description:
Today, Assystem is among the top three independent nuclear engineering firms worldwide. With over 60 years of experience in highly regulated sectors, the group supports public and industrial stakeholders in the execution of complex and strategic infrastructure projects, subject to high safety and security requirements.


Assystem mobilizes 8,000 experts in 13 countries and intervenes across the entire project lifecycle, in engineering, project management and digital solutions.


Overview


Working on a major nuclear power plant project with experience in Databricks, the Data Engineer will be responsible for designing, developing, testing, and supporting data products that underpin reporting, analytics, and operational decision-making across the project programme.


Working within a multidisciplinary Data & Analytics team, the successful candidate will use Databricks, SQL, Python, and Microsoft technologies to deliver robust, scalable, and maintainable data solutions. They will collaborate closely with Data Architects and Performance Analysts to transform business requirements into high-quality data products that support project performance reporting across safety, quality, schedule, cost, and operational functions.


This role requires a Data Engineer who can work independently, take ownership of technical delivery, and contribute to the continuous improvement of the organisation's data platform.


Key Responsibilities



  • Design, develop, and maintain data products using Databricks and associated Azure technologies.

  • Build scalable ETL/ELT pipelines to ingest, transform, and load data from multiple enterprise systems.

  • Develop data transformations using PySpark, Spark SQL, SQL, and Python.

  • Create and maintain curated datasets that support business intelligence, reporting, and analytics.

  • Implement data quality, reconciliation, validation, and monitoring processes.

  • Optimise data pipelines and workloads to improve performance, reliability, and cost efficiency.

  • Support the development of reusable engineering frameworks, templates, and standards.


Delivery & Support



  • Translate business requirements and functional designs into technical solutions.

  • Develop, test, document, and deploy data products in line with established engineering standards.

  • Support production data products and resolve issues impacting data quality or availability.

  • Participate in release, deployment, and change management activities.

  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives across the data platform.

  • Work closely with Data Architects to ensure solutions align with enterprise architecture and data standards.

  • Collaborate with Performance Analysts and business stakeholders to understand reporting and analytical requirements.

  • Communicate technical solutions and implementation approaches clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Ensure compliance with Information Design Authority (IDA) governance processes.

  • Maintain appropriate technical documentation, data lineage, and support materials.


Qualifications



  • Minimum 2 years' experience delivering data engineering or business intelligence solutions.

  • Strong proven commercial experience with Databricks.

  • Strong experience developing ETL/ELT pipelines and data integration solutions.

  • Experience using Apache Spark, PySpark, and Spark SQL.

  • Strong SQL development and optimisation skills.

  • Experience working with large and complex datasets from multiple source systems.

  • Knowledge of data modelling principles and analytical data structures.

  • Experience implementing data quality and reconciliation processes.

  • Experience working with Power BI and data visualisation solutions.

  • Understanding of semantic models, reporting datasets, and business intelligence concepts.

  • Ability to support analysts in delivering meaningful reporting and insights.

  • Databricks certification.

  • Experience within construction, infrastructure, engineering, utilities, energy, or regulated industries.

  • Familiarity with Integrated Management System (IMS) or similar governance frameworks.

  • Knowledge of Power BI advanced features and dashboard development.

  • Experience with automation using VBA or Python.


Qualifications



  • Degree or equivalent qualification in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related discipline.

  • Relevant Databricks, Azure, or Power BI certifications are desirable.


Software Experience



  • Databricks

  • SQL Server

  • Power BI

  • Python


Additional Information


What we offer



  • Hybrid Working – Flexibility to work from home and the office

  • Buy & Sell Holiday – Make your time off work for you

  • 8% Company Pension Contributions

  • Competitive Sick Pay – Support when you need it

  • Healthcare Cash Plan – Claim back on dental, optical & more

  • Free Digital Gym Access – Expert-led fitness classes

  • Exclusive Discounts – Restaurants, days out & top brands

  • 24/7 Employee Support Line – Mental health, financial & legal help

  • Volunteer Days – Make a difference on company time


Join Assystem and become a key player in delivering critical nuclear projects that shape the future of energy. Embrace this opportunity to excel in a dynamic environment where your expertise and leadership will drive global innovation.

Please note that we will never offer specialist CV writing services, request payment or ask for sensitive personal information during the recruitment process.


We are committed to equal treatment of candidates and promote, as well as foster all forms of diversity within our company. We believe that bringing together people with different backgrounds and perspectives is essential for creating innovative and impactful solutions. Skills, talent, and our people’s ability to dare are the only things that matter !. Bring your unique contributions and help us shape the future.

title: Customer Operations Assistant
description:
ProAmpac is seeking a multi-site Customer Operations Assistant to join our team! This position will initially train onsite at our Neenah and Wrightstown, WI facilities, with the opportunity to transition to a remote or hybrid work arrangement following training.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to build a career in Customer Operations, gain exposure to key customer accounts and manufacturing operations, and grow within a global organization.

Location: Remote | (Must be available to Train in Neenah, WI)

Hours: Monday – Friday | 8am – 4pm

Wage: $22 - $25+/hour (Based on Experience)

Why ProAmpac:

ProAmpac is one of the fastest-growing global leaders in flexible packaging, driven by our core values of Impact, Involvement, Integrity, Innovation, and Intensity.

We invest in our people with a comprehensive benefits package, including multiple medical, dental, and vision plan options, a 401(k), and generous paid time off. Our collaborative culture and commitment to continuous improvement have fueled our growth—and we’re looking for motivated individuals who are ready to grow their careers along with us.

Position Summary:

  • The Customer Operations Assistant supports the Customer Operations team in delivering a high level of service to key and strategic accounts. This role provides day-to-day administrative and operational support helping ensure customer orders, account information, reporting, and internal requests are handled accurately and efficiently.
  • The Customer Operations Assistant will work closely with internal teams including Customer Operations, Scheduling, Quality, Operations, Sales, and other plant functions to gather information, investigate issues, maintain account data, and support the overall needs of assigned accounts.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Provides day-to-day support to Customer Operations Representatives across a select group of key and strategic customer accounts.
  • Assists with order entry and order management, ensuring information is entered accurately and maintained appropriately.
  • Creates and maintains customer status reports, spreadsheets, trackers, and other account documentation.
  • Pulls, organizes, and analyzes account and operational data to support customer requests and internal decision-making.
  • Investigates order, production, quality, scheduling, and delivery questions by gathering information from appropriate internal teams.
  • Collaborates cross-functionally with Scheduling, Quality, Operations, Customer Service, Sales, and plant personnel to obtain information and assist the customer operations team resolve issues.
  • Maintains accurate customer and order information within applicable systems and ensures documentation is current.

Qualifications & Skills

  • Customer service, administrative support, order management, manufacturing, or similar experience preferred.
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy, particularly when working with orders, customer information, and large amounts of data.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and comfort working with spreadsheets, reports, and data.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and changing needs.
  • Demonstrated critical thinking and problem-solving skills with a willingness to investigate issues rather than simply escalate them.
  • Approachable and collaborative, with the ability to build strong working relationships across departments.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Self-motivated and willing to take initiative while knowing when to ask questions or seek additional guidance.
  • Coachable and receptive to feedback, with an interest in continued learning and development.

Growth Opportunity

This role provides an opportunity to develop a strong understanding of customer operations, account management, manufacturing processes, and cross-functional collaboration. Successful individuals may have the opportunity to expand into customer-facing responsibilities and progress into more advanced Customer Operations positions as they gain experience.

Are you excited about shaping the delivery experience for one of Amazon's fastest fulfillment programs? The R2L Operations and Optimization team is looking for a Senior Product Manager to drive product strategy for our Sub-Same Day (SSD) delivery network. You will own the product development lifecycle for technology solutions that power faster-than-same-day delivery across North America — defining product vision, collaborating with engineering and science teams to turn complex requirements into customer-facing products, and guiding development from conception through launch. This is a high-visibility role where you will work through ambiguity, make decisions with limited data, and use your data analytics skills to shape multi-year roadmaps that directly improve the delivery experience.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the product strategy and roadmap for SSD delivery technology solutions, aligning customer needs, business requirements, and operational constraints to drive delivery experience improvements
- Define product requirements through customer research, data analysis, and cross-functional stakeholder collaboration, making sound trade-off decisions when data is incomplete
- Drive product development in close partnership with science and engineering teams, covering feature prioritization, acceptance criteria, and launch readiness
- Build metrics frameworks to measure product success, find the highest-leverage input metrics, and use data to guide iteration and roadmap priorities
- Work across engineering, design, operations, and business teams to deliver complex products within the SSD delivery network while keeping stakeholders aligned

A day in the life
You will start many mornings reviewing operational metrics and delivery partner feedback to spot emerging opportunities or issues. From there, you may jump into working sessions with engineering and science partners to refine product requirements, followed by alignment discussions with operations, design, and business teams. Much of your work is proactive and roadmap-driven, requiring you to balance long-term planning with near-term delivery decisions in an environment where clarity often needs to be created rather than inherited.

Amazon offers a full range of benefits that support you and eligible family members, including domestic partners and their children. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment.

The benefits that generally apply to regular, full-time employees include:
- Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage
- Maternity and Parental Leave Options
- Paid Time Off (PTO)
- 401(k) Plan

If you are not sure that every qualification on the list above describes you exactly, we'd still love to hear from you!

At Amazon, we value people with unique backgrounds, experiences, and skillsets. If you’re passionate about this role and want to make an impact on a global scale, please apply!

About the team
The R2L Operations and Optimization team builds technology products that power Amazon's Sub-Same Day delivery experience. Our mission is to improve delivery speed and the overall delivery experience through scalable, data-informed product solutions. We work in a collaborative environment where product managers partner closely with engineers, scientists, and operations teams to solve complex logistics challenges. This role offers a clear path to grow into broader product leadership, with the scope and visibility to own multi-year roadmaps and take on increasing responsibility over time.

title: Product Manager
description:
What We Need

CORPAY is currently looking to hire a Product Manager within our North American Trucking division. This position falls under our US Vehicle Payments line of business and is located in Atlanta, GA.

Corpay's North American Trucking team operates differently than a typical large enterprise product organization. While we're part of a global company, our team runs with the speed, ownership, and accountability of a startup.

We're looking for a Product Manager who is energized by ambiguity, thrives with autonomy, and enjoys building products and businesses from the ground up. This isn't a role where you are given a roadmap, you'll define your own way, drive alignment, and own execution from concept through launch and beyond.

One day you may be interviewing customers and writing product requirements. The next you might be reviewing UI designs, developing go-to-market materials, negotiating strategic partnerships, analyzing product performance, or working with engineering to solve technical challenges. Success requires someone who is equally comfortable thinking strategically and rolling up their sleeves to execute.
If you're looking for a role with clearly defined boundaries, this probably isn't it. If you're excited by ownership, variety, and building products that make a measurable impact, we'd love to meet you.

You will report directly to the VP of Connected Vehicle Products and regularly collaborate with the team and other departments.

How We Work

As a Product Manager, you will be expected to work in an office environment. CORPAY will set you up for success by providing:

Assigned workspace in the Buckhead Atlanta office.
Company-issued equipment + remote access

Role Responsibilities
The responsibilities of the role will include:

Owning outcomes, not just features. Take full ownership of products and initiatives from idea through launch and ongoing optimization, ensuring they deliver measurable customer and business value.
Driving product strategy and execution. Identify opportunities through customer research, market insights, data analysis, and internal collaboration, then translate those opportunities into actionable roadmaps and product plans.
Leading product development. Define requirements, write epics and user stories, prioritize backlogs, make trade-off decisions, and partner closely with engineering to deliver high-quality solutions across both modern platforms and legacy systems.
Being the voice of the customer. Develop a deep understanding of carriers, drivers, fleet operators, and internal users to ensure we're solving meaningful problems with intuitive, scalable solutions.
Shaping the user experience. Collaborate with UX and engineering to review designs, simplify workflows, and create exceptional customer experiences across web, mobile, and internal applications.
Bringing products to market. Partner with Sales, Marketing, Operations, Customer Success, and Training to develop positioning, launch plans, enablement materials, and adoption strategies that maximize product success.
Using data to drive decisions. Define success metrics, monitor product performance, and continuously iterate based on customer feedback, analytics, and business results.
Leading through influence. Build alignment across Engineering, Operations, Sales, Credit, Risk, Finance, and executive leadership to move initiatives forward in a highly collaborative environment.
Wearing multiple hats. This role extends well beyond traditional product management. On any given day, you may be writing product requirements, reviewing UI designs, developing marketing content, supporting customer conversations, negotiating partnerships, or solving operational challenges. We value people who embrace variety and are willing to jump in wherever needed.

Qualifications & Skills

4–7 years of product management experience or equivalent experience leading cross-functional initiatives and bringing products or platforms to market.
Proven ability to independently lead initiatives from concept through execution, balancing customer needs, business objectives, and technical considerations.
Strong product instincts with experience identifying customer problems, validating opportunities, and translating them into successful product solutions.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders across engineering, commercial, operations, and executive teams.
Strong technical aptitude with the ability to work effectively with engineers on APIs, integrations, system architecture, and technical trade-offs. You don't need to code, but you should be comfortable understanding how systems work.
Experience working in Agile product development environments and collaborating closely with engineering and design teams.
Comfortable making decisions with imperfect information, adapting quickly as priorities evolve, and maintaining momentum in fast-moving environments.
Highly organized with exceptional prioritization skills and the ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously.
Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

Preferred Experience and Skills

Strong preference for a background with card or virtual payment systems, transportation payments and fuel programs, fleet logistics.
Experience with credit, risk, or compliance considerations in financial products.
Comfort using analytics tools and SQL or similar to explore data and validate hypotheses.
Experience working with geographically distributed teams and operating in a high-growth or transformative environment.

Automatic enrollment into our 401k plan (subject to eligibility requirements)

Employee discounts with major providers (i.e. wireless, gym, car rental, etc.)

Fun culture with company-wide contests and prizes

title: Senior Production Planner
description:
Job Summary

The Senior Production Planner is responsible for developing, maintaining, and executing the assembly production schedule within an Engineer-to-Order (ETO) manufacturing environment. The role aligns customer orders, engineering releases, material availability, and plant capacity to meet delivery commitments.

This role serves as the primary planning liaison between the Site Master Scheduler, Project Management, Engineering, Supply Chain, Production, and the Fabrication Planning team, translating complex project requirements into executable shop-floor schedules.


Job Duties and Responsibilities

Assembly Scheduling & Execution

  • Translate the SIOP-driven master schedule into a rolling 12-week production plan aligned with plant capacity, ramp-ups, customer orders, engineering releases, and lead times.
  • Monitor shop-floor progress and schedule adherence, adjusting priorities as needed.
  • Own performance metrics, including schedule attainment, on-time delivery to customer commitments, and WIP levels.
  • Maintain accurate scheduling data within Epicor.
  • Recommend / Propose plans & actions to mitigate at-risk delivery commitments.

Master Schedule Alignment

  • Act as the primary link between the Site Master Scheduler and shop-floor execution.
  • Manage the schedule impact of engineering changes (ECOs), customer revisions, and supply disruptions, and coordinate master schedule updates with the Master Scheduler and other stakeholders.

Capacity & Constraint Management

  • Proactively identify bottlenecks and constraints (capacity, material, fabricated components, and engineering releases) and coordinate cross-functional actions to resolve them.
  • Escalate risks to delivery commitments and recommend recovery or mitigation plans when needed.

Cross-Functional Planning & Communication

  • Coordinate with Engineering, Supply Chain, Production, Quality, and Project Management to align design releases, material availability, and manufacturing execution.
  • Lead daily and weekly production scheduling reviews with production supervisors, PMO, and the fabrication team.

Continuous Improvement

  • Identify opportunities to improve assembly flow, resource utilization, schedule adherence, and planning processes.
  • Support and Drive the development and standardization of production planning and scheduling processes.
  • Mentor and develop production coordinators as the team grows.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree with 4+ years of experience in production planning, scheduling, or manufacturing operations; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
  • Advanced ERP/MRP proficiency with a strong understanding of BOM structures, routings, master scheduling, and capacity planning.
  • Experience coordinating across Engineering, Supply Chain, Project Management, and Manufacturing.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and make effective decisions in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and production scheduling tools.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in an Engineer-to-Order (ETO), Make-to-Order (MTO), or project-based manufacturing environment.
  • Experience with SIOP/S&OP and master scheduling processes.
  • Epicor ERP experience.
  • APICS CPIM or CSCP certification.

Benefits:

  • PTO/ESST
  • Paid holidays
  • $100 individual deductible and $300 family deductible health insurance
  • Paid Weekly
  • Vision and Dental Insurance
  • 401K / Life Insurance / STD

Asset

description:
Program Quality Assistant

title: Coordinator, Medical Education
location: RFUMS Main Campus, North Chicago, IL, US
description:
Compensation: $26.94 per hour


Position Summary

The Coordinator, Medical Education plays a critical role in advancing the effective delivery of the Foundational Sciences curriculum within the Chicago Medical School. This position provides high-level coordination and operational management to ensure that medical education programs, courses, and faculty-led sessions are delivered seamlessly in both virtual and in-person settings.

Reporting to the Department Chair, Vice-Chair, Education Directors, and the Manager of Medical Education, the Coordinator serves as a central hub for curriculum operations, schedule management, instructional technology, and academic program support. The Coordinator partners closely with faculty, staff, and students to foster an organized, efficient, and learner-centered environment that supports the school’s academic mission.

Our generous benefits package includes medical, dental, and vision plans; paid parental leave; short term and long-term disability plans; life insurance; flexible spending accounts; and a 403(b) retirement plan which includes an 8% employer contribution after 2 years of service. RFUMS is committed to employee wellbeing and work-life balance. Full time staff are eligible for 3 weeks of vacation / personal leave, 15 sick days, and 13 holidays plus 2 floating holidays.


Who We Are

Rosalind Franklin University of Medicine and Science (RFU) is a graduate health sciences university committed to serving the population through the interprofessional education of health and biomedical professionals and the discovery of knowledge dedicated to improving wellness. The university embodies the spirit of inquiry and excellence modeled by its namesake Dr. Rosalind Franklin, whose Photo 51 was crucial to solving the structure of DNA.

Today, the university’s 6 colleges continue Dr. Franklin’s legacy through rigorous academics, pioneering research, and innovative community service. Our unique interprofessional education model allows students to learn from and with each other in a variety of settings, including our simulation labs, the student-led Interprofessional Community Clinic, and through partnerships with area hospitals and clinics. RFU is a national leader in interprofessional research and practices, and is nationally recognized for its research in areas including neuroscience, brain-related diseases, inherited disorders, proteomics, cancer cell biology and immunology, cardiac resuscitation, and gait and balance.


Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Curriculum & Program Coordination

  • Coordinate day-to-day operations and logistics for medical education courses, blocks, and threads to ensure programs run smoothly.
  • Update and distribute course syllabi, schedules, and upload all lecture materials to the learning management system in collaboration with Block/Course Directors.
  • Monitor and communicate schedule changes in real time, ensuring timely updates to students, faculty, and administrative staff.
  • Track and report student attendance and course participation in accordance with institutional requirements.

Technology & Learning Platforms

  • Manage and optimize use of educational technologies and learning platforms (e.g., D2L, ExamSoft, Zoom, NBME, Google Workspace) to support instruction and assessment.
  • Administer and proctor M1 and M2 exams and quizzes, both in-person and virtual, ensuring secure, consistent, and professional testing environments.
  • Coordinate secure administration of assessments, ensuring compliance with institutional standards and confidentiality protocols.
  • Stay current with innovations in instructional technology and recommend enhancements that improve course delivery and student engagement.
  • Coordinate classroom and meeting room technology (A/V, videoconferencing, recording, etc.).

Faculty & Student Support

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for faculty regarding course logistics, instructional technology, and program operations.
  • Provide clear and consistent guidance to students on course requirements, testing procedures, and institutional policies.
  • Manage preparation, verification, and dissemination of grades, evaluations, and official course communications.
  • Assist with department meetings, including scheduling, agenda prep, and taking minutes.

Administrative & Records Management

  • Maintain comprehensive and well-organized academic records, ensuring compliance with institutional and accreditation standards.
  • Draft, edit, and distribute professional correspondence, reports, and program documentation on behalf of faculty and leadership.
  • Protect confidentiality and uphold integrity in handling sensitive student and program information.
  • Support departmental initiatives, special projects, and continuous quality improvement efforts as directed by program leadership.


Conditions of Employment

  • Must achieve satisfactory results from a background check


Required Education & Experience

  • Associate’s degree required (or equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience).
  • Experience coordinating complex schedules, programs, or projects in a professional setting.


Required Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities

  • Advanced computer proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint), Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Slides, Drive, Forms), Adobe Acrobat, and database/records management systems.
  • Ability to learn and apply educational technologies (LMS platforms, videoconferencing tools, exam software).
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to prepare professional correspondence, reports, and instructional materials.
  • Exceptional organizational and project management skills with attention to accuracy, deadlines, and process improvement.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and ability to work effectively with faculty, students, administrators, and external partners.
  • Commitment to confidentiality and professional integrity.
  • Proven ability to exercise discretion, maintain confidentiality, and uphold professional integrity in handling sensitive information.
  • Capacity to work both independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, academic environment.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred (or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience).
  • Demonstrated experience in higher education, healthcare, or academic program administration.
  • Experience analyzing data and preparing reports to support program evaluation and continuous improvement.


Work Environment, Schedule, and Physical Demands

  • Position is based on-campus and in-person at the Chicago Medical School.
  • Work performed in a standard office environment with regular use of computers and office equipment.
  • Duties primarily involve sitting, standing, and light physical activity.
  • Occasional local travel and attendance at educational conferences may be required.
  • Regular, reliable on-site attendance is required to support faculty, students, and program operations.
  • Following a successful 90-day onboarding and training period, the coordinator may be eligible for a flexible schedule allowing up to one remote workday per week, subject to approval by the Manager of Medical Education and departmental needs.


Typical Physical Demands & Working Conditions

  • Selected candidate must have the mental and physical capabilities to perform the essential functions of the position with or without reasonable accommodations.

title: Mortgage Loan Processor- On site
description:

We are seeking an experienced Mortgage Loan Processor to manage the processing of mortgage loan applications from initial submission through approval and closing. In this role, you’ll work closely with borrowers, Loan Officers, Underwriters, title and escrow companies, appraisers, insurance providers, real estate professionals, and other partners to ensure loan conditions are obtained, reviewed, and cleared accurately and on time.

The ideal candidate is organized, detail-oriented, and customer-focused, with strong knowledge of mortgage lending guidelines and the ability to manage multiple loans and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

What You'll Do

  • Process and package mortgage loans accurately and within established timelines.
  • Monitor daily processing requests and manage multiple loan files throughout the process.
  • Communicate with borrowers regarding underwriting conditions and follow up to obtain required documentation.
  • Open title and escrow and coordinate with title and escrow professionals throughout the transaction.
  • Order and follow up on appraisals, payoffs, flood certifications, verification of employment, compliance reports, and other required documentation.
  • Prepare and update Loan Estimates and Closing Disclosures as needed.
  • Review and audit appraisal reports and address identified issues or conditions.
  • Work closely with Underwriting to obtain approval and clear outstanding conditions.
  • Coordinate pre-closing loan packages with internal Compliance and Quality Control teams.
  • Obtain final approval to close and submit completed files to the Closing/Funding team.
  • Work with closing attorneys, title and escrow officers, real estate agents, and other professionals involved in the loan transaction.
  • Ensure all loan files meet applicable lending policies, guidelines, compliance requirements, and established deadlines.
  • Maintain accurate and organized loan files and documentation.
  • Participate in training, department meetings, cross-training, and other initiatives as assigned.
  • Support department and Credit Union goals and objectives.

What We're Looking For

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Minimum of three years of mortgage loan processing experience.
  • Strong knowledge of conventional, non-conforming, and HELOC lending guidelines.
  • Experience with Encompass or another loan origination system.
  • Proficiency with Desktop Underwriter (DU) and Loan Prospector (LP).
  • Working knowledge of real estate lending compliance requirements.
  • Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Outlook, Word, Teams, and Excel.
  • Excellent communication, organization, and time-management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and maintain an organized workflow.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
  • Ability to work independently while also collaborating effectively with a team.
  • Strong member service skills and a commitment to providing an exceptional member experience.
  • Ability and willingness to learn new systems, processes, and procedures.

Why You'll Love This Role

As a Mortgage Loan Processor, you’ll play an important role in helping members achieve their homeownership goals. You’ll have the opportunity to work with a variety of lending professionals while using your expertise to keep mortgage transactions moving efficiently from processing through closing.

If you’re an experienced mortgage professional who enjoys organization, problem-solving, and helping members navigate the lending process, we’d love to hear from you!

title: Sr AI Engineer, AI Engineering, LATAM
description:
Are you passionate about helping customers solve complex technical challenges? As a Sr AI Engineer at Amazon, you will partner directly with customers to design and deliver technical solutions that drive real business outcomes — from reducing costs to launching new products. You will combine your technical depth with business understanding to architect solutions that are secure, scalable, reliable, and performant. This role puts you at the intersection of technology and business strategy, where your recommendations shape how customers build and grow on our platforms. If you are a collaborative problem-solver who thrives on translating ambiguous requirements into well-architected designs, we want to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities
- Design end-to-end technical solutions for customers by understanding their business context, outcome priorities, and technology challenges, while applying sound judgment on trade-offs such as load distribution, data store choice, scaling strategy, and failover mechanisms.
- Serve as a trusted technical advisor to customers, diving deeply into technical details, identifying opportunities and risks, and contributing to constructive discussions that improve their experience with our technologies.
- Leverage existing design patterns and reusable architectures where appropriate, and create new solution designs with potential for future reuse across the organization when existing patterns do not fit.
- Develop and deliver technical content including presentations, workshops, and written guidance that incorporates lessons learned from customer engagements, and share best practices with both technical and non-technical audiences.
- Collaborate with internal teams across sales, engineering, professional services, and support to progress customer opportunities, identify product gaps, and translate customer feedback into actionable technical requirements.

A day in the life
You start your morning reviewing a customer's architecture proposal, identifying areas where the design can be simplified or made more resilient. By midday, you are leading a working session with a customer's engineering team, whiteboarding a migration strategy and walking through the implications of different approaches. In the afternoon, you might join a peer design review with fellow architects, contribute feedback on a colleague's solution, or draft a reusable reference architecture based on a pattern you recently delivered.

About the team
Our team of Solutions Architects works closely with customers to turn complex technical problems into practical, well-designed solutions. We are a collaborative group that values knowledge sharing, peer reviews, and continuous learning. Our mission is to help customers succeed by meeting them where they are and guiding them toward architectures that support their long-term goals. We are focused on building an inclusive environment where every team member's perspective strengthens the solutions we deliver and the customers we serve.

title: Space Management Project Manager
description:
The Department of Facilities Management & Development at SUNY Downstate Health Sciences University is seeking a full-time Space Management Project Manager.

Under the supervision of the Assistant Vice President (AVP) for Management Operations in the office of the SVP/CAO with dotted line reporting to Facilities Management and Development (FMD), the primary responsibilities for the Space Planning Project Manager are the policy formation for managing all space change projects and the documentation by providing space planning expertise, updating and generating AutoCAD space inventories and databases, analyzing existing space utilization, developing campus-wide policies on space allocation and usage, preparing special reports detailing specific project space needs, generating space allocation plans for various campus wide surveys, programming space summaries and preliminary planning test fits and furniture plans for end-user planning review and signoff, updating campus AutoCAD base building and plans, and exporting AutoCAD data for import into the SUNY Space management database (currently Assetworks Aim). This position will also participate in capital spending decision-making and generally be advising the most senior leadership of Downstate.

SPACE PLANNING LEADERSHIP: The Space Planning Project Manager will generate presentation materials, floor plans, space utilization reports and other graphic products to assist with the visualization and communication of planning findings for space steering and space policy committee meetings.

GENERATE & UPDATE DIGITAL SPACE DATA in AUTOCAD and SUNY Assetworks AIM format: Conduct field documentation, measurements, surveys and data collection of use and occupancy of existing on and offsite campus spaces. Assist with the development, maintenance and updating of a comprehensive space management database, including an inventory of all property, infrastructure, buildings, space, departmental allocations and assigned staff spaces. The inventory must be kept current at all times and include critical data about existing space including vacancy and use data, as well as net square footage. This will be coordinated with other campus data sets and provides baseline data for other department led surveys including for example, Property Management equipment surveys, Research Reimbursement Rate Surveys, and AAALAC animal space surveys. Manage the ongoing update and yearly review of onsite and offsite physical space configuration, usage, and classification using NCES FICM (National Center for Education Statistics Facilities Inventory and Classification Manual) space codes utilizing the software system (currently Assetworks AIM and ReADY), and terminology as defined by SUNY Office of Capital Facilities (OCF).

STRATEGIC PLANNING and CAMPUS WIDE COLLABORATION: Work with others to contribute to the development and ongoing realignment of SUNY Downstate's Facilities Master Plan ("the Campus Facilities Master Plan"), working with University and Hospital leadership, the SUNY Downstate Research Foundation, HSCB Foundation and Real Estate Office, Downstate Health Physicians and other campus end-users to incorporate documentation of affiliated offsite space, in addition to SUNY owned space, currently in use to support the SUNY Downstate mission of healthcare, research and education. Collaborate with SUNY Downstate Health Sciences University’s Facilities Management Department, Design and Construction Group, Buildings & Grounds, Operations, Information Technology, Public Safety and Asset Management departments, and departmental user groups to provide documentation of space planning needs required for Design and Construction implementation (by others). Frequently review and propose uses of existing, underutilized space. Collaborate with consultants and contractors such as architects, furniture vendors, and installers to develop and document space and furniture planning standards. Develop policies, new reporting tools and planning standards for future projects as required.

ABILITY TO REMAIN FLEXIBLE & COMFORTABLE WITH SHIFTING PRIORITIES & CONSTRAINTS:

Academic Medical Centers are complex siloed organizations that are constantly evolving. NY state procedures and systems add complexity to simple workflows. Use of professional judgement to maintain efficiency and flexibility and good humor while adjusting to changes in leadership priorities, shifts in funding, evolution of accreditation criteria, and phased implementation of SUNY OCF systems, software and priority initiatives. Other duties as may be assigned to focus on the space management mission and deliverables.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelors’ Degree in Architecture, Interior Design, or related field

  • 3+ years of professional experience in space planning, design, or construction management and administration

  • Or a satisfactory equivalent of education, training, and experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • Strong computer skills, including proficiency with AutoCAD, Adobe Creative Suite, Microsoft Office Suite

  • Demonstrated knowledge of space planning and functional programming principles, and best industry practices
